# MobileWatch — the complete bestiary

Generated 2026-08-02 from `mobs.json`. **6,810 monsters** across **202 families** in **21 ecosystems**, **1,591 ability definitions**. 2,582 are flagged notorious monsters; 5,997 have at least one zone recorded.

This is the whole record in one file — nothing here is summarised or truncated. Part 1 is every ability definition, Part 2 is every monster.

## How to read it

**Resistances.** A number is the difference from neutral, the way the wiki writes it minus 100. `Fire +50%` means the wiki says 150% damage taken. `Ice -50%` means 50%. A weakness or resistance with **no number** is a direction the source stated without a magnitude — treat it as "weak" or "resistant" and nothing more.

**Damage types** are Physical, Magical, Breath, Slashing, Impact, H2H, Piercing and Ranged. Note the app draws Impact under the label **Blunt**; the data says `Impact`. A handful of families with a swipeable multi-element grid store the same row as `Blunt` so it matches their resist set — those are noted on the family.

**Detection** vocabulary: `Sight`, `Sound`, `Scent`, `Magic`, `JA` (job abilities), `Blood` (low HP — almost always an undead family), `True Sight` and `True Sound`. `True Sight` and `True Sound` see through Invisible and Sneak respectively.

**Flags.** `NM` notorious monster · `Aggressive` attacks on sight · `Links` calls its neighbours.

**Crystal** is the crystal the mob drops. `Varies` means it follows the mob's own element (the Aern, Ghrah and Craver classes); `None` means the page states it drops none.

**Zones** are `Zone (level band)`, semicolon separated. A zone with no band means the level was never recorded for that zone specifically.

**Absent fields are absent, not empty.** If a monster has no `Drops` line, nothing is recorded — it does not mean it drops nothing.

# Part 2 — The bestiary

## Ecosystem: Amorph

10 families, 393 monsters — Acuex, Botulus, Flan, Hecteyes, Leech, Plovid, Sandworm, Slime, Slug, Worm

### Family: Acuex

*Ecosystem Amorph · 22 recorded*

> Resistant to physical damage like other slimes.
> Weak to breath damage, magical damage, and skillchains. Magic-based effects that ignore resistance, such as Quick Draw, will not deal extra damage.
> Resistant to Slow (via its Earth resistance); however, Despoil applies Slow when successfully stealing Acuex Poison.
> Traits: Sleep Resistant and Bind Resistant — an enhanced resistance rank against those effects, separate from elemental resistance.
> A slime-like mold from the underworld that likes caves and other dark places.
> The Yecuex is a variety of Acuex that appears in Alluvion Skirmish and Vagary. It possesses 20 magic defense and absorbs 30~100 TP with its attacks.

- Drops: Gerra's Staff, Supernal Knife, Asteria, Athos's Tabard, Rubeus Jacket, Beaivi's Scepter, Riftcinder, Riftdross, Heavy Metal, Crystal Petrifact
- Notes:
    - Title: Botulus Rex Engorger. Spawned as part of the quest VW Op. 118: Buburimu Squall.
    - Uses several different types of normal melee attack — Frontal: single-target damage plus max HP down (~20%); Frontal: AoE damage (double) plus Amnesia; Side: AoE damage (triple) plus knockback; Rear: AoE damage (quadruple) plus Stun.
    - Has a high physical damage taken reduction but takes normal magic damage. Has a constant Bio aura (20 HP/tick) and Auto Regen.
    - Casts all -ja spells and Meteor, with a fairly high Fast Cast trait.
    - Can use Chainspell multiple times, first at 65-80% HP; the next use comes several minutes later and will not occur if it is defeated quickly enough. Fool's Drink should be used to survive Chainspell — the extremely large AoE on Meteor makes it nearly impossible to survive otherwise, short of staggering it. It will not use TP moves or normal melee attacks while Chainspell is active.
    - Has 137 INT, 89 MND, +12.5% Magic Damage Taken, and 40 Magic Defense Bonus.
    - One or more of its TP moves may reset hate.
    - As of the February 2012 version update, timing weakness triggers with TP moves or spells correctly yields increased alignment/weakness duration.
    - Also drops Level 91-99 spell scrolls, various crafting materials, the Atmacite of the Shrewd and the Dusky periapt of vigilance key items.

- Notes:
    - Title: Zerde Zapper. M.DEF 130.
    - Upon spawning, immediately begins using Just Desserts, which spawns x4 adds — Drisheen (BLM), Haupia (WHM), Kacamak (BLM) — with Bio, Plague, Doom and Curse auras. If Just Desserts is used again, more adds spawn on top of the existing ones.
    - You cannot afford a single resist. Consider opening with Elemental Seal Stun and having a dedicated player or two on rotations; with buffs a player should be fine landing stun without boosts like Elemental Seal.
    - Uses several different types of normal melee attack — Frontal: single-target damage plus max HP down (~20%); Frontal: AoE damage (double) plus Amnesia; Side: AoE damage (triple) plus knockback; Rear: AoE damage (quadruple) plus Stun.
    - Initially has a moderate amount of DT-% which is removed by staggering it. Blue proc is achieved by magic bursting high tier Fire spells or a fire magical WS; procing blue will terrorize it.
    - Hit rate data: with vorseals worn and 1323 Acc, hit rate parsed at 54%; averaged with TP Offhand on another person at 1130 Acc it was 19%. With the same gear plus vorseals (~1440 acc), hit rate was capped on other HELMs and all the lower tiers.
    - Apart from being largely dependent on a competent stunner, this is a fairly straightforward battle.
    - Slimy Proposal is only used below 50% HP.
    - Also unlocks the STR/VIT Vorseal.

#### Lamprey Lord
- Level: 82
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Dark Knight
- Crystal: Water
- Respawn: 3600s
- Weak to: Fire +30%, Light +50%, Ice +30%
- Resists: Impact -25%, H2H -25%, Water -50%, Dark -30%
- Abilities: Acid Mist
- Zones: North Gustaberg; North Gustaberg [S]; Pashhow Marshlands; Pashhow Marshlands [S]
- Spawn: Voidwalker (rest in its vicinity while in possession of a Colorful abyssite)
- Drops: Hirudinea Earring
- Image: mobimages/leech.png
- Notes:
    - Does not cast any magic. Possesses increased movement speed (12%). Drops enmity very frequently.
    - One spawn per zone, with a 60 minute respawn timer after the last kill.
    - Confirmed locations — North Gustaberg: E-9/F-9, I-5, I-7 on the second level of the hill. North Gustaberg [S]: E-10/E-11 Line, J/K-8, D-8, J-5, L-7. Pashhow Marshlands: K-9 south of the maw, G-6/H-6, G-10. Pashhow Marshlands [S]: I-7 near the pond, I-8/I-9 Line, I-10 close to pond, E/F-5 close to pond, near the F/G-10/11 point.
    - Only uses Acid Mist as its TP move: AoE damage, Attack Down and hate reset. Wipes shadows and has a longer readying time than normal. If Acid Mist is stunned, it will briefly gain a Paralyze Aura.
    - Slow, Blind and Stun have been confirmed to land; Head Butt stun does land. Immune to Drain and Dread Spikes.
    - Can use Blood Weapon multiple times randomly. Has a very high percentage of Double Attack and Triple Attack.
    - Extremely high percentage (~80%) of Additional Effect: Poison whenever Blood Weapon is not active. Poison damage varies but can deal upwards of 200-300 HP/tick, and overrides Poison Potions.
    - Trial of the Magians: required objective for Trial 223, Trial 651, Trial 717 and Trial 948 (6 kills each).
    - Also drops the Orange abyssite key item.

### Family: Plovid

*Ecosystem Amorph · 4 recorded*

> Regular attacks are one of three abilities: Jumping Slam (AoE physical damage and poison), Tongue Lash (single-target physical damage and poison), or Spit (conal, magical Water damage and poison).

#### Dhartok
- Level: 145
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Job: Warrior / Black Mage
- Crystal: Water
- Resists: Fire -30%, Wind -30%, Lightning -30%, Light -30%, Ice -50%, Earth -15%, Dark -95%
- Absorbs: Water
- Abilities: Nullifying Rain, Noyade, Cesspool, Clobbering Wave, Fetid Eddies
- Zones: Outer Ra'Kaznar [U] (145)
- Content: Sortie: Bosses: Major
- Spawn: Sortie battlefield (past Diaphanous Gadget #E)
- Drops: Ra'Kaznar Frag. #1, Ra'Kaz. Starstone, Old Case, Old Case +1
- Image: mobimages/dhartok.png
- Notes:
    - Sortie NM. Found past Diaphanous Gadget #E; requires a Ra'Kaznar Shard #E to access.
    - ~1,620,000 HP, 1,581 EVA, 100 M.DEF. Traits: INT 363, MND 338. Title: Dhartok Defiler. Also awards 10,000 Gallimaufry.
    - Resists Geomancy 50% (a separate row on its resistance grid).
    - Its attacks and TP moves inflict a stacking Taint debuff that grows in potency with each successive effect. Taint cannot be removed by Erase, Esuna, Sacrifice, Poisona, Full Cure or Benediction — only by Chakra, and only from Monk main job.
    - After enough Taint or Poison stacks, Clobbering Wave and Noyade can deal lethal damage (8,000+).
    - Requires a Ra'Kaznar Metal #E to limit its abilities: while in possession its attacks inflict Poison instead of Taint, so the debuff can be removed by any usual source — doing so resets the damage multiplier.
    - Absorbs Water damage and retaliates with severely increased damage afterwards. This includes magic and skillchain damage, including a Darkness skillchain, but not Hydro Breath from a Dragoon wyvern's Elemental Breath. Absorbing also degrades the durability of your seal.
    - Using Cesspool grants a 3-minute aura that lets it use two TP moves in a row. While the aura is up a miasma cloud is placed at its target's location when the second TP move's animation finishes; the clouds inflict Drown and Magic Defense Down on players standing near them. Maximum 16 clouds — Cesspool can still be used after that, but no further clouds are created.
    - Possesses a cumulative damage resistance wall against repeated Weapon Skills, similar to Dynamis Divergence Wave 3's Mega Boss.
    - Ability variants (Taint replaces the family's poison aura): Nullifying Rain — damage, Taint for 5 minutes. Noyade — damage and Silence, Taint -40 HP/tic for 5 minutes. Cesspool — damage, Taint for 5 minutes. Clobbering Wave — damage and Knockback, damage scaling proportionally with the Taint/Poison on the player. Fetid Eddies — damage, Taint -30 HP/tic for 5 minutes.

You need Ra'Kaznar Metal #A to be able to remove the Poison (via spell or item) — being in possession of it changes the debuff to a regular Poison effect — or kill it before the stacks get too high.

#### Onychophora
- Level: 150
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Warrior / Black Mage
- Crystal: Earth
- Resists: Impact -37.5%, H2H -37.5%, Fire -75%, Wind -50%, Lightning -75%, Light -75%, Ice -75%, Earth -95%, Water -75%, Dark -75%
- Abilities: Aeolian Void, Disgorge, Doomvoid, Dustvoid, Gorge, Psyche Absorption, Slaverous Gale
- Spells: Addle, Slowga, Stone V, Stonega IV, Fire V, Firaga IV, Stone VI, Stonega V, Fire VI, Firaga V
- Zones: Reisenjima (150)
- Content: Geas Fete: Reisenjima: HELM
- Spawn: Forced — examine ??? with an Onychophora's soil; all members require Tribulens or Radialens
- Drops: Firangi, Gozuki Mezuki, Lembing, Navon Crackows
- Notes:
    - Geas Fete NM. EVA 1,386, M.DEF 140. Title: Onychophora Obliterator. Assisted by Onychophora's Sandworm.
    - Spell tiers by HP: Addle and Slowga throughout; above 50% Stone V, Stonega IV, Fire V, Firaga IV; below 50% it switches to one tier higher — Stone VI, Stonega V, Fire VI, Firaga V. Casts roughly every 30-35 seconds.
    - Throughout the fight: will NOT absorb damage during Slaverous Gale, Disgorge and Dustvoid, but WILL absorb damage during Aeolian Void, Gorge and Psyche Suction.
    - Below 50% HP it also switches absorption mode based on the spell it casts: a Fire spell triggers magical absorption (all magic heals it) until a Stone spell is cast — after a Fire spell, do physical damage; a Stone spell triggers physical absorption (all physical damage heals it) until a Fire spell is cast — after a Stone spell, do magical damage. The mode changes once the spellcasting completes. Between 50%-25% HP, using the appropriate damage type during casting is acceptable.
    - Below 25% HP it additionally absorbs all damage during any spellcasting.
    - It has no innate Silence resistance but continues to behave as if it were not silenced, switching modes silently and changing the absorption damage type. Silence is potentially useful in a group at 25% and lower to limit healing while it is casting.
    - Spawns Onychophora's Sandworm after any skillchain performed on it — x2 for a Lv1, x4 Lv2, x6 Lv3, x8 Lv4 (Light->Light etc.). Repeating a skillchain will not spawn more on top of existing ones unless a higher level skillchain was performed.
    - Counterattacks with Doomvoid — a 1-shot K.O. for the entire alliance — if hit with the same skillchain repetitively. The same skillchain may not be repeated within the last five skillchains performed.
    - Builds power for Disgorge by absorbing damage as well as by using Gorge. A backup tank is advised.
    - Its unique TP move (called Psyche Suction in its notes, Psyche Absorption in the tables) is an unremovable and significant Impact-style stat reduction.
    - Dustvoid removes all equipped gear but does not inflict Encumbrance — have a macro ready to re-equip.
    - Relatively low attack power compared to other Reisenjima HELM monsters. Approximately 453 AGI.
    - Also awards a Luck+ Vorseal.

- Spawn: Timed — one of seven [S] zones (48-72 hours after being defeated, or 20-25 hours after Doomvoid)
- Notes:
    - Spawns in only one of the seven zones below 48-72 hours after being defeated, or 20-25 hours after using Doomvoid, with a strong preference for approximately 23 hours. Despawns after 1 hour if left unclaimed, and respawns in a random zone after 1-3 hours.
    - Doomvoid can be used under 40% HP. As with any monster, under 25% HP Sandworm will use an ability immediately upon reaching 1000 TP. Doomvoid pulls all alliance members in range into another zone: in northern Quon to Everbloom Hollow to fight King Arthro; in southern Quon to Ruhotz Silvermines to fight Guivre (which runs away repeatedly — use large bursts of damage); in Mindartia to Ghoyu's Reverie to fight Serket. There is a chance for Lambton Worm to appear in place of any of the above NMs.
    - Killing Sandworm without allowing Doomvoid to occur grants the title "Sandworm Wrangler".

#### Fistule
- Level: 90
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Warrior
- Crystal: Water
- Respawn: 900s
- Weak to: Fire +15%, Wind +30%, Lightning +15%, Ice +15%, Earth +15%, Water +15%
- Resists: Magical -25%, Slashing -50%, Impact -75%, H2H -75%, Piercing -50%, Ranged -50%, Light -15%, Dark -15%
- Abilities: Digest, Fluid Spread, Fluid Toss, Cytokinesis, Dissolve
- Zones: Abyssea-Konschtat
- Content: Abyssea: Abyssea-Konschtat: NM
- Spawn: Timed (15-20 min.) — cannot be targeted until Bloodguzzler, Guimauve or Lentor are brought to aggro at (G-3), north of Conflux #6
- Drops: Lightsome Cap, Scathacha, Rokugo Hachimaki, Fistl. Discharge, Vision Card, Vision Stone
- Image: mobimages/fistule.png
- Notes:
    - Abyssea NM. 1 spawn. Title: Fistule Drainer.
    - After Fistule becomes targetable by absorbing one of the three NMs (Bloodguzzler, Guimauve, Lentor), it is immediately claimed by the player who had hate on the NM that spawned it — the player who receives the Turbid slime oil key item at the end of the fight, if obtained.
    - Will spawn 2 Pustules after the TP move Cytokinesis. The Pustules will split into smaller Pustules if defeated.
    - Drops 1-2 Fistl. Discharge. Also awards the Atma of Vicissitude.
    - Boils share the Clot element row but additionally take only 75% magical damage.
    - Clots and Boils are the only slimes that use Epoxy Spread and Mucus Spread.

### Family: Slug

*Ecosystem Amorph · 17 recorded*

> Gains an auto-regen II (12/tick) during Rain weather.
> Tracks by scent, and loses track of the player quickly during rain weather or through water — such as in Pashhow Marshlands [S].
> The Encumbrance from Fuscous Ooze and Mucilaginous Ooze used to also remove equipment from the player. This was changed in the October 7th 2014 update due to how powerful the loss of iLvl equipment was.
> Despoil: Slug Eye (Accuracy Down).

#### Dyinyinga
- Level: 65-68
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sound, Scent
- Job: Warrior
- Crystal: Water
- Weak to: Fire +15%, Lightning +15%, Ice +15%
- Resists: Impact -25%, H2H -25%
- Immune: Sleep

- Drops: Mahant Sandals
- Image: mobimages/slug.png
- Notes:
    - 7,675 HP, no MP, M.DEF 100. Trait: Enslow.
    - Lottery spawn from the middle Scabrous Slug in the group of 3 above the Goblin Patrolman and beneath the Goblin Draftee on Wide Scan, at the top level of Brutus's Field (J-9) — one of the two Slugs on the hill leading to the mountain/fence, north-west of the pond.
    - Will attempt to stick to the player by constantly moving until directly on top of the player's position. This makes meleeing difficult for the player with hate — you may lock on and walk backwards to compensate.
    - Inflicts a Silence and Amnesia aura on players within 0.5 yalms. It wears off ~5 seconds after moving away.
    - Possesses an Enslow effect of ~30% which overwrites and prevents the application of Haste II / Erratic Flutter. The slow lasts ~45 seconds; while it is active Dyinyinga stops trying to stick to the player and the Silence/Amnesia aura ceases, resuming immediately after it wears off.
    - Gains a 10/tick auto-regen during rain weather. Has an enhanced movement speed of roughly 25%.
    - Susceptible to Gravity, Bind and Break, but builds resistance. Also susceptible to Slow, Silence and Paralyze.
    - Also drops a Slug Eye.

### Family: Worm

*Ecosystem Amorph · 68 recorded*

> Immobile.
> Will not cast magic unless their target is out of melee range. This does not apply to all worms, but often applies to Notorious Monsters.
> Casts earth-based magic only, and Bind.
> Worms in the original areas are a job of BLM/BLM, while Rise of the Zilart worms are BLM/RDM.
> Despoil: Copper Ore, Darksteel Ore, Iron Ore, Silver Ore, Zinc Ore (Defense Down).

    - ~5,800 HP, M.DEF 100. Trait: Auto-Regen. Also awards an Earth Crystal.

    - Appears as a GREY worm, while the other worms around it of the same name are a standard brown.
    - Is not aggressive, but links with surrounding worms, and surrounding worms link with it.
    - Uses standard Worm family TP moves and spells, but only casts when a player leaves melee range.
    - Has a potent Auto-Regen of 1% HP per tick (~50+/tick).
    - Susceptible to Blind, Bind, Break, Silence, Gravity, Paralyze, Poison, Slow, Stun and Sleep.
    - Will despawn if a player loses enmity and it deaggros.

## Ecosystem: Aquan

10 families, 370 monsters — Crab, Craklaw, Frog, Orobon, Pteraketos, Pugil, Rockfin, Ruszor, Sea Monk, Uragnite

### Family: Crab

*Ecosystem Aquan · 119 recorded*

> Despoil: Land Crab Meat (Slow), Crab Shell (Defense Down).
> Standard kit is 5 moves. Mega Scissors and Venom Shower are restricted: Mega Scissors is used by Karkinos, Krabimanjaro and Krabkatoa, Venom Shower by those three plus Krabakarpo.
> Bubble Shower is a breath-type move: its damage scales with the crab's remaining HP.

- Level: 125

- Immune: Stun
- Absorbs: Water
- Abilities: Big Scissors, Bubble Curtain, Bubble Shower, Metallic Body, Scissor Guard
- Zones: The Boyahda Tree (125)
- Content: Unity: Wanted: Wanted 2
- Spawn: UNM (2,100 Unity Accolades)
- Drops: Ayapec's Coffer: Ayapec's Shell, Hike Khat, Hike Khat +1, Perun, Perun +1
- Notes:
    - Unity NM in The Boyahda Tree. Rift locations: (D-6), (I-10), (H-6). 2,100 Unity Accolades.
    - ABSORBS Water damage; the only Crab that does. The rest of its element row matches the family exactly.
    - Possesses an un-dispellable en-water with a very low melee delay.
    - Opens the battle immediately with Scissor Guard followed by Metallic Body — Scissor Guard grants a dispellable +100% defense boost, Metallic Body grants a stoneskin effect.
    - Cycles TP moves: Bubble Curtain > Scissor Guard > Crab Shell > Bubble Shower. Bubble Curtain grants a dispellable -50% MDT.
    - Uses Bubble Shower several times in a row — starting at x3 and increasing as its HP falls — and each successive use is +25% power. Dispelling any buff triggers Bubble Shower immediately.
    - Its en-water and Bubble Shower can also take a Water day and/or weather bonus on top of that +25%.
    - Any spike damage has a chance to proc blue and freeze it ~10 seconds; further spike damage while frozen can proc white, which resets the timer and strips all of its defense boosts and buffs.
    - Immune to Stun.

- Spawn: UNM (1,800 Unity Accolades)

- Notes:
    - Unity NM in Jugner Forest. Rift locations: (I-6), (I-9), (J-11). 1,800 Unity Accolades. ~52,000 HP, 200 M.DEF. Traits: Guard, Counter, Kick Attacks.
    - An upgraded version of King Arthro.
    - MNK NM, so it has Double Attack, Kick Attacks and Counter — which can look like quadruple or quintuple attacks.
    - Casts Waterga V exclusively, on a 30 second recast, except during Hundred Fists.
    - Uses standard Crab TP attacks.
    - While it uses TP attacks or casts spells, ALL damage dealt to it is reduced to 0-1 — time damage outside that window.
    - Has Enparalyze normally, replaced with Enwater during Hundred Fists (20-21 damage with 5/5 Shellra V and Barwatera).
    - Uses Hundred Fists repeatedly after a period of time or amount of damage taken. It casts no spells and does no TP attacks during it, so that is the window to maximize damage.
    - Susceptible to Absolute Terror, which may keep it from shifting phases. A skillchain with 2 DDs followed by 1-2 strong magic bursts can end it quickly during Hundred Fists.

#### Krabakarpo
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Paladin
- Crystal: Water
- Weak to: Fire +30%, Wind +30%, Lightning +50%, Light +30%, Ice +50%, Earth +30%, Dark +30%
- Resists: Water -30%
- Abilities: Big Scissors, Bubble Curtain, Bubble Shower, Metallic Body, Scissor Guard, Venom Shower
- Spells: Bindga, Paralyga, Silencega, Graviga, Dispelga, Blizzard IV / V, Blizzaga IV / V, Blizzaja, Water IV / V, Waterga IV / V, Waterja
- Zones: Foret de Hennetiel; Cirdas Caverns [U]
- Spawn: Forced (trade Zaffre Yggrete Shard V to ???)
- Drops: Brethren Axe, Mondaha Cudgel, Alternator, Zaffre Yggzi V, Airlixir, Airlixir +1
- Notes:
    - Delve NM. Foret de Hennetiel: trade a Zaffre Yggrete Shard V to the ??? at (F-9). Also in Cirdas Caverns [U] via the Foret de Hennetiel Fracture (after 15 minutes, or once NMs I-III are defeated). Key item: Semi-pure zaffre yggzi.
    - USES VENOM SHOWER.
    - As damage of one type is dealt (physical or magical), its resistance to that type increases over time.
    - Exploitable Weakness: focus one type of damage for at least half its HP, then the other type for the rest. Formless Strikes counts as magical damage for this. Murasamemaru, Requiescat and Twilight Scythe deal damage that is not affected by the reduction.
    - Scissor Guard and Bubble Curtain reduce physical and magical damage taken by 90% respectively, last 30 seconds, and cannot be dispelled.
    - Its Venom Shower is a 20' AoE of powerful water damage plus a potent, irremovable Poison — only Chakra removes it — so mages and support need to hold their positioning.

#### Krabkatoa
- Level: 90
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Paladin / Warrior
- Crystal: Water
- Respawn: 7200s
- Weak to: Fire +30%, Wind +30%, Lightning +50%, Light +30%, Ice +50%, Earth +30%, Dark +30%
- Resists: Water -100%
- Immune: Paralyze, Bind, Gravity, Weight, Poison, Sleep
- Abilities: Big Scissors, Bubble Curtain, Bubble Shower, Metallic Body, Scissor Guard, Mega Scissors, Venom Shower
- Zones: East Ronfaure (90); East Ronfaure [S] (90); Jugner Forest (90); Jugner Forest [S] (90)
- Spawn: Voidwalker (rest with Blue abyssite)
- Drops: Black abyssite, Krabkatoa Shell, Igneous Barnacle, Acubens Helm, Karka Ring
- Image: mobimages/crab_3.png
- Notes:
    - Voidwalker NM. Title: Krabkatoa Steamer. ~24,000 HP. Possess: rest with a Blue abyssite. Respawns every 2-4 hours.
    - IMMUNE TO WATER DAMAGE.
    - USES MEGA SCISSORS AND VENOM SHOWER.
    - Metallic Body is undispellable here and grants a ~1,000 HP Stoneskin — the client may say you dispelled it if you are quick enough, but the effect remains.
    - High Double Attack rate, a modest TP Regain, and Enhanced Movement Speed (+25%).
    - Bubble Shower's range is huge — players can be hit by it without seeing the "readies" message.
    - Venom Shower can be evaded by a height difference, just like Astral Flow, and leaves a Plague aura afterwards. 229 water resist was enough to fully resist its damage and the poison completely.
    - Always executes TP moves, even if nobody is in range.
    - Susceptible to Slow, Elegy and Blind. Immune to Paralyze, Bind, Gravity, Weight, Poison and Sleep.
    - Will depop when it has no enmity on anyone, but will NOT depop if it has been taken too far from its spawn area.
    - The Karka Ring can only drop if it spawns with a visible shadow.
    - Its render is the barnacle-encrusted model, not the standard crab.

#### Marsh King Arran
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Monk
- Crystal: Water
- Weak to: Fire +30%, Wind +30%, Lightning +50%, Light +30%, Ice +50%, Earth +30%, Dark +30%
- Resists: Water -30%
- Abilities: Big Scissors, Bubble Curtain, Bubble Shower, Metallic Body, Scissor Guard, Hundred Fists
- Spells: Poisonga II, Waterga IV
- Zones: Jugner Forest
- Spawn: Timed (5 min, H-6 — after all 10 Mini Knight Crabs are killed)
- Drops: Save the Queen II
- Notes:
    - REMOVED FROM THE GAME — no longer accessible as of the May 2018 update.
    - Spawned at (H-6) in Jugner Forest. Initially 10 Mini Knight Crabs spawn around the shore at (H-6); they do not aggro but they link with each other. Once all 10 were killed, Marsh King Arran spawned about 2 seconds after the last one faded from the screen.
    - If the Mini Knight Crabs were not killed within 5 minutes once aggroed, they raged over time and got significantly stronger, so holding them was not advised (the same as King Arthro's Knight Crabs).
    - Special attacks: Poisonga II, Waterga IV, and all standard Crab TP attacks. Used Hundred Fists once per fight.
    - Big Scissors could do substantial damage (reported up to 2400+), so blink tanking with a trust was advised. Melee attacks had an additional effect of Paralyze.
    - Gave 4,350 XP and 1,255 CP at level 99, plus 15,976 gil.

*Ecosystem Aquan · 11 recorded*

> Normal melee attacks can be one of three types: Slash (a 3-hit attack), Pincer (conal, additional effect Defense Down -20%), and Spin (AoE, additional effect Stun). These are melee variants, not TP moves.
> Despoil: Craklaw Pincer (Attack Down).
> Standard kit is 4 moves.

    - Spells: None.

    - Exploitable Weakness: as one type of damage is dealt, resistance to that damage type increases noticeably and damage taken from other types increases exponentially. The damage susceptibility resets shortly after Riptide Eupnea is used. Example: a Monk that melees with Formless Strikes without weaponskilling for a while (to roughly 80~85% HP) can then weaponskill and drop Formless Strikes for extremely fast, high damage.

### Family: Frog

*Ecosystem Aquan · 28 recorded*

> DOES NOT HAVE ANY TP ABILITIES — the whole family. Possesses low melee delay instead.
> Links with other Frogs, and also with Poroggos.
> Magic Defense by colour: Green Toads 100, Red Toads 100, Blue Toads 70.
> Lore: during the Age of Magic the Windurstian hero Samariri used forbidden magic to enlarge the toads being trampled on the paths of Windurst Waters; they kept growing and turned into beastmen (the Poroggos). The toads of the Sarutabaruta area and the Flume Toads in the canals beneath Windurst are uniquely extra large and have MP, which is why researchers believe they are the closest living relatives of the toads from the old texts.

#### Bismarck
- Level: 95-98
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sound
- Crystal: Water
- Resists: Fire -15%, Wind -40%, Lightning -30%, Light -50%, Ice -40%, Earth -15%, Water -30%, Dark -30%
- Abilities: Caudal Capacitor, Deep Sea Dirge, Baleen Gurge, Waterspout, Angry Seas, Blowhole Blast, Echolocation, Depth Charge, Thar She Blows, Mighty Strikes
- Spells: Water IV, Water V, Waterga III, Waterja, Flood II, Thunder IV, Thunder V, Thundaga III, Thundaja, Burst II
- Zones: Bibiki Bay - Purgonorgo Isle
- Spawn: Voidwatch (Voidwatch Path: Hyacinth II; rifts on Map 2, Purgonorgo Isle, at (F-9), (J-9) or (I-10))
- Drops: Delphinius, Drakaina Lance, Phalaina Locket, Porthos Byrnie, Sealord Skin, C.Abjuration: Lg., F.Abjuration: Lg., L.Abjuration: Lg., S.Abjuration: Lg., T.Abjuration: Lg., Heavy Metal, Riftdross, Riftcinder, Crystal Petrifact
- Notes:
    - Title: Bismarck Flenser.
    - Assisted by up to ten Primordial Pugils: five spawn a few seconds after Bismarck, and more come in groups of up to five periodically thereafter (no more spawn while all ten are being held). The pugils only use normal attacks and Recoil Dive.
    - Has high evasion and physical defense and/or PDT-. Possesses approximately -15~20% player critical hit rate.
    - Regular attacks reduce all targets' accumulated TP by half and give a status effect depending on which side the attack was received from: frontal attacks add Defense Down or Slow, side attacks add Paralyze, and rear (tail) attacks are the most powerful and add Terror.
    - Occasionally gains a moderately strong Shock Spikes effect. Can use Mighty Strikes multiple times throughout the fight.
    - Bismarck has no Fast Cast, and its spells are particularly easy to stun or out-range as they all have lengthy casting times.
    - Also drops Sealord Skin, level 91-99 spell scrolls and assorted crafting materials, plus two key items: Atmacite of the Depths and Periapt of recompense.
    - This grid as "Standard Resistances": every damage type at 100%, every element resisted, and no weakness anywhere. Light (50%) and Wind (60%) are the deepest resists.

#### Pakecet
- Level: 135
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Warrior / Black Mage
- Crystal: Water
- Resists: Fire -30%, Wind -30%, Lightning -30%, Light -15%, Ice -50%, Earth -50%, Water -50%, Dark -70%
- Abilities: Aetheric Pull, Angry Seas, Baleen Gurge, Caudal Capacitor, Deep Sea Dirge, Echolocation
- Spells: Dispelga, Sleepga II, Flood II, Thundaga V, Water V, Water VI, Thunder V, Thunder VI
- Zones: Escha RuAun
- Content: Geas Fete: Escha RuAun: Tier 3
- Spawn: Forced (examine the ??? with a Pakecet's blubber; all members require Tribulens or Radialens)
- Drops: Xucau Mantle, Tutyr Sabots, Uac Jerkin, Kurys Gloves, Bu.Abjuration: Bd., Jo.Abjuration: Bd., Tr.Abjuration: Bd., Ve.Abjuration: Bd., Eschalixir, Eschalixir +1, Eschalixir +2, Eschite Ore
- Notes:
    - Title: Pakecet Pacifier. M.DEF 110. Assisted by Pakecet's Pugil x3-10.
    - Three spike moves rotate its defenses, and using one replaces the current spikes and magic nullification effect: Aetheric Pull grants Dread Spikes, Baleen Gurge grants water spikes, Caudal Capacitor grants Shock Spikes. Each nullifies the damage taken of one element while active and moves another resistance (to 115%, 100% and 130% respectively).
    - Procing removes the spike effect. Fire or Light damage, or skillchains, may cause this proc, but that is unconfirmed.
    - Angry Seas spawns three to ten pugils of roughly 4,500 HP each; the number summoned increases as Pakecet's HP decreases, and they are aggressive to whoever spawned Pakecet. Using Echolocation while they are out makes them change targets at random. The pugils are susceptible to sleep and petrify.
    - When the one-hour animation is performed, all adds use Berserk, pick a random target and attack it for a period of time (60s?). Tanks cannot pull hate off the targeted party members during this window; the adds can be slept until it wears off.
    - Be careful when grouping up - 2-3 Recoil Dives (conal) may kill weaker members instantly.
    - A second grid, "Horned Resistances". It is not uniformly tougher than the Standard: Ice, Earth, Water and especially Dark (30%) are far more resistant, but Fire and Light are LESS resistant than the Standard's, and Light moves from the deepest resist on the Standard grid (50%) to the shallowest on this one (85%).
    - Aetheric Pull is restricted to this subspecies.

### Family: Rockfin

*Ecosystem Aquan · 3 recorded*

> Every member is an NM - Dakuwaqa (Delve), Ngai (Odyssey) and Tchakka (Wildskeeper Reive). There is no standard Rockfin.
> It is all resistance and no weakness: Fire and Water 15%, Dark 30%, Lightning and Earth 70%, Wind/Light/Ice 50%.
> Auto-attacks are chosen from one of three types: Bite (single target, Defense Down), Thrust (conal, knockback) and Spin (spins in place, AoE, knockback).
> Shared kit of six TP moves, ungated: Protolithic Puncture, Aquatic Lance, Pelagic Cleaver, Carcharian Verve, Tidal Guillotine and Marine Mayhem. Carcharian Verve is the pivot - it buffs the user and opens the window for Marine Mayhem, which is only ever used straight after it.

#### Dakuwaqa
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sound
- Abilities: Aquatic Lance, Carcharian Verve, Marine Mayhem, Pelagic Cleaver, Protolithic Puncture, Tidal Guillotine
- Spells: Aero III, Aero IV, Aero V, Aeroga III, Aeroga IV, Aeroga V, Aeroja, Bindga, Blizzaga III, Blizzaga IV, Blizzaga V, Blizzaja, Blizzard III, Blizzard IV, Blizzard V, Dispelga, Graviga, Paralyga, Poisonga II, Silencega, Sleepga, Water III, Water IV, Water V, Waterga III, Waterga IV, Waterga V, Waterja
- Zones: Cirdas Caverns [U]
- Spawn: Foret de Hennetiel Delve Fracture - clear all NMs
- Drops: Illapa, Izhiikoh, Tsurumaru, Whirlpool Mask, Whirlpool Greaves, Sangoma Ring, Eddy Necklace, Airlixir +1, Airlixir +2, Rockfin Fin, Rockfin Tooth
- Image: mobimages/dakuwaqa.png
- Notes:
    - Delve boss for Foret de Hennetiel. Title: Dakuwaqa Trawler. HP 1,250,000. 1 spawn.
    - 74-50%: resists piercing, susceptible to blunt; 49-25%: resists magic, susceptible to slashing; below 25%: resists slashing, susceptible to magic.
    - A group leaning on blunt damage can drop Formless Strikes to accelerate the first 25%, then re-add it (with Hundred Fists) to accelerate the next 25%.
    - Can be slept with light-based sleep.
    - Its HP bar is shrouded for the whole fight and is only revealed while the Carcharian Verve aura is up; it disappears again shortly after the aura ends.
    - Carcharian Verve fires as the first TP move and as the first move below 75%, 50% and 25% HP, then randomly below 25% whenever the water spear is down. It is always followed by Marine Mayhem - keep non-melee at maximum casting distance. Its two buffs should be dispelled immediately (high Magic Accuracy needed).
    - While the water spear is active Dakuwaqa is immune to Stun and casts its highest-tier spells. After each scripted Carcharian Verve it also gains a 30s Ice Spikes effect - that one is the Foret de Hennetiel zone buff and cannot be dispelled. Thunder attacks are less resisted while the spear is up, and enough thunder or total damage removes it (RUN sub with Sulpor works).
    - Its debuffs and the element and tier of its nukes both shift by HP phase - 100-75%: Poisonga II, Paralyga, Bindga + Water/Waterga/Blizzard/Blizzaga IV; 74-50%: Paralyga, Silencega, Graviga + Blizzard V, Blizzaga IV, Aero IV, Aeroga IV; 49-25%: Silencega, Poisonga II, Sleepga + Water V, Waterja; below 25%: Sleepga, Silencega, Dispelga + Blizzard V, Blizzaga V, Water V, Waterga V.
    - Also drops the key item Craggy fin.

#### Ngai
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sight
- Resists: Fire -95%, Wind -75%, Lightning -70%, Light -75%, Ice -75%, Earth -75%, Dark -75%
- Absorbs: Water
- Abilities: Aquatic Lance, Bite, Carcharian Verve, Marine Mayhem, Mighty Strikes, Pelagic Cleaver, Protolithic Puncture, Spin, Thrust, Tidal Guillotine
- Spells: Dispelga, Sleepga, Water V, Waterga IV
- Zones: Sheol - Gaol
- Content: Odyssey: Sheol Gaol: Atonement 3
- Image: mobimages/ngai.png
- Notes:
    - Odyssey NM. Title: Ngai Nabber. At Vengeance 20 it has 3.2 million HP; recommended accuracy ~1,241.
    - Physical 100%, Magical and Breath "?". Its own General Notes say the same in prose.
    - Uses Mighty Strikes at 75% HP in Vengeance 15 and above, and a second time at 40% HP in Vengeance 21 and above.
    - Red proc: one Weaponskill followed by multiple simultaneous Weaponskills from different players inside the ~3 second Skillchain window - 2 Weaponskills the first time after the red proc, 3 the next, and so on. A player cannot repeat a WS during the window or the process must restart. An automaton can open the red proc with Strobe, Flashbulb, Shield Bash or a WS, but interrupts the process if it uses another during the window.
    - Adds: Ngai's Craklaw spawns at 75% HP in the Vengeance 20 fight, and a second one at 40% HP in Vengeance 25. Ngai gains a potent Regen while they are up, more potent with the second.
    - Drops no equipment - the key item Information on Ngai allows players to purchase the Gleti's equipment.

#### Tchakka

    - DAMAGE TAKEN IS PROPORTIONAL TO THE COLONIZATION RATE of Foret de Hennetiel - it takes less damage as the rate falls, and 0 damage at very low rates. That resistance is ignored by damage that bypasses shields, such as Quick Draw.

- Level: 85
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sight, Scent
- Job: Warrior / Red Mage
- Crystal: Water
- Weak to: Fire +15%, Lightning +15%
- Resists: Wind -15%, Ice -50%, Water -60%, Dark -15%
- Immune: Bind, Break, Gravity, Paralyze, Sleep

- Zones: Beaucedine Glacier [S] (85)
- Spawn: Timed (4-5 hrs) (J-7), near the pond
- Drops: Angel Skin, Ebur Pigment, Oxblood, Papilio Kirpan, Ruszor Hide, Shagreen
- Notes:
    - Title: Scylla Skinner. HP 35,675. M.DEF 100. Traits: Double Attack, Fast Cast.
    - Draws in the entire alliance, including "dead" members, to a point just in front of the canyon leading to Fei'Yin. Draw-in fires whenever a player is about 15' away, but never during the aura phases from Frozen Mist or Hydro Wave.
    - Casts Bindga, Paralyga or Poisonga II every 60-90 seconds, and will cast even during the aura TP-spam phases; its Fast Cast bonus cuts casts to 1-2 seconds.
    - Has access to all Ruszor TP moves, but its behaviour changes under the aura from Frozen Mist or Hydro Wave: for 45 seconds it gains an enhanced aura and readies the matching instant move back-to-back every 3-4 seconds - Frozen Mist pairs with Ice Guillotine (-50% Max HP Down for 3 min, Amnesia 45~60s, 10' Paralysis aura), Hydro Wave with Aqua Cannon (Knockback 10', -50% Defense Down for 3 min, 10' Silence aura).
    - Possesses a moderately potent Humanoid Killer - it procs often enough to occasionally cause two or even four intimidations in a row.
    - Very high resistance to Souleater, which makes a DRK zerg impossible.
    - Susceptible to Blind, Slow, Stun and Silence, though Silence wears off very quickly.
    - If the alliance fighting it wipes it despawns immediately, with the message that the monster fades before your eyes with a look of disappointment on its face.

### Family: Uragnite

*Ecosystem Aquan · 18 recorded*

> Hides in its shell after being out of it for 40 seconds. Dealing physical damage above a threshold sends it into its shell early - the threshold is the mob's current HP divided by 10, rounded down, and never goes below 1% (so at 100% HP it is 10%).
> The shell lasts 9 ticks (27 seconds), and it recovers 1% HP a tick (every 3 seconds) while inside.
> Gains double defense and takes -75% magic damage while inside its shell.
> Will retaliate with Gas Shell if physically attacked while inside its shell.
> Has a longer than usual melee delay at 290.
> Despoil: Seashell (Magic Defense Down) and Uragnite Shell (Defense Down).

#### Aberrant Uragnite
- Flags: NM

- Crystal: Water

- Spawn: Forced (trade Zaffre Yggrete Shard II to ??? (J-7/8))
- Drops: Bokwus Slops, Mikinaak Greaves, Mephitis Grip, Zaffre Yggzi II
- Image: subtypes/limascabra.png
- Notes:
    - A Limascabra.
    - This grid as "Limascabra Resistances": every damage type at 100%, Lightning 130%, Fire and Water 50%, everything else neutral. It is the flatter of the two sets - the same two resists dug slightly deeper, and none of the Uragnite set's six weaknesses except Lightning.
    - The pale, smooth-shelled second model. Amphitrite and Aberrant Uragnite are the family's Limascabras.

#### Amphitrite
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Paladin
- Crystal: Water
- Weak to: Lightning +30%
- Resists: Fire -50%, Water -50%
- Abilities: Gas Shell, Painful Whip, Palsynyxis, Suctorial Tentacle, Venom Shell, Virulent Haze
- Zones: Abyssea-Grauberg
- Content: Abyssea: Abyssea-Grauberg: Zone Boss
- Spawn: Forced (examine ??? at (F-10) with a Variegated uragnite shell)
- Drops: Chimeric Fleuret, Aqua Sachet, Wieldance Card, Wieldance Jewel, Atma of the Sea Daughter, Battle trophy: 2nd echelon
- Image: subtypes/limascabra.png
- Notes:
    - Spawns with a random damage absorption mode, and does not go into its shell at all.
    - Absorbs Physical Damage - triggered by using Palsynyxis; the change occurs after a delay.
    - Absorbs Magical Damage - triggered by using Painful Whip; the change occurs after a delay.
    - It always casts a spell after a TP move, so the mode change appears to happen when the spell is cast. Stunning the TP move keeps it in a favourable mode.
    - After absorbing damage it counters with Virulent Haze, whose Addle lands even on a player in i119 gear with high magic evasion.
    - Also awards Atma of the Sea Daughter and Battle trophy: 2nd echelon.
    - This grid as "Limascabra Resistances": every damage type at 100%, Lightning 130%, Fire and Water 50%, everything else neutral. It is the flatter of the two sets - the same two resists dug slightly deeper, and none of the Uragnite set's six weaknesses except Lightning.
    - The pale, smooth-shelled second model. Amphitrite and Aberrant Uragnite are the family's Limascabras.

### Family: Caturae

*Ecosystem Arcana · 36 recorded*

> Arcana chess-piece NMs — each has Black/White model variants (Pawn through King).
> Many gain a damage-immunity shield via Stygian Sphere or Tabbiyaa Gambit; magic damage (or a random damage type) removes it.
> Jobs and elemental resistances vary per member; most are tier-V Black Mage casters.
> Six chess-piece models (Black/White each): Pawn=Sippoy, Knight=Kutharei, Bishop=Yaanei, Rook=Iratham, Queen=Rani, King=Raja — every other member reuses one of these six.

#### Fu
- Level: 139
- Flags: NM
- Job: Warrior
- Resists: Magical -12.5%, Fire -30%, Wind -30%, Lightning -30%, Ice -50%, Earth -50%, Water -50%, Dark -80%
- Abilities: Mighty Strikes, Draw In, Stygian Sphere, Malign Invocation, Diabolic Claw, Deathly Diminuendo, Hellish Crescendo, Stygian Cyclone, Ebullient Nullification, Interference
- Zones: Reisenjima Henge (139)
- Content: Omen: Bosses: Midboss
- Image: mobimages/caturae_knight.png
- Notes:
    - Casts Paralyze, Paralyga, Poisonga II, Water V, Waterga IV, Blizzard V, Blizzaga IV. Uses Mighty Strikes once.
    - Ebullient Nullification (dispels/absorbs all buffs within 20') at 100/75/50/25/10% HP. It does NOT dispel or absorb Aftermath, Dematerialize, runes, or other non-dispellable buffs.
    - Just after using it Fu takes significantly enhanced damage for a short time (more with more buffs absorbed), and gains attack and magic-attack boosts that scale with the number of buffs absorbed. The sweet spot for a group is ~4-7 buffs; letting it absorb more makes it much stronger and it can melee for thousands per hit.
    - Its intimidation rate is inverse to buffs absorbed (few buffs absorbed = very high intimidation; many = very low).
    - If claimed from more than 20' away it draws in the alliance and uses Ebullient Nullification on everyone. On a wipe/full reset it can redo Ebullient Nullification and Mighty Strikes; partial resets will not.

#### Kei
- Level: 139
- Flags: NM
- Job: White Mage
- Weak to: Fire +50%, Wind +50%
- Resists: Light -30%, Ice -50%, Earth -50%, Water -50%, Dark -90%
- Abilities: Benediction, Stygian Sphere, Stygian Cyclone, Hellish Crescendo, Diabolic Claw, Malign Invocation, Deathly Diminuendo, Dancing Fullers, Interference
- Zones: Reisenjima Henge (139)
- Content: Omen: Bosses: Midboss
- Notes:
    - Uses Benediction once, as early as 80% HP.
    - Has permanent elemental spikes that inflict Slow (overwrites Haste; resistable/reducible with magic evasion, ~30-50 damage per hit, painful for dual-wield/multi-attack). The spikes cycle to show its current weakness: Blaze Spikes = susceptible to Water, Wind Spikes = susceptible to Ice. The active element follows Kei's last successful cast (e.g. casting Aeroga IV while Blaze Spikes are up turns them to Wind Spikes).
    - Has a permanent shield that absorbs all incoming magic damage (including DoT) and grants a strong Regen. Physical damage is significantly reduced while the shield is up.
    - The shield drops for ~4-5s when a skillchain lands (best window to burst, and magic hits much harder then). The Regen is separately removed briefly by dealing the element opposite the current spikes; magic must be sustained to keep it down (eyes glowing = Regen active; it reactivates in 3-4s if the counter-element isn't dealt).
    - Interference (from 25% HP): magic damage + Dispel + Knockback; the damage can be resisted but the Dispel cannot. Dancing Fullers at 75/50/25/10%: 2,500 AoE within 10' per person including Luopans, unaffected by Sentinel's Scherzo / Elemental Sforzo / One for All / DT gear. Dodge it by standing outside 10' but NOT beyond 20', or it Draw-Ins first and wipes the party. It won't re-use Dancing Fullers after Benediction for a % it already used.
    - Has very high evasion for a Black Mage type.

#### Ou
- Level: 139
- Flags: NM
- Job: Red Mage
- Resists: Magical -12.5%, Fire -30%, Wind -30%, Lightning -30%, Ice -50%, Earth -50%, Water -50%, Dark -80%
- Abilities: Deathly Diminuendo, Diabolic Claw, Hellish Crescendo, Malign Invocation, Stygian Sphere, Stygian Cyclone, Ebullient Nullification, Unfaltering Bravado, Chainspell, Dancing Fullers, Zero Hour, Target, Eleventh Dimension, Interference, Gardez, Prophylaxis
- Spells: Addle, Diaga, Diaga III, Dispel, Dispelga, Stun, Slowga, Impact, Meteor, Holy
- Zones: Reisenjima Henge (139)
- Content: Omen: Bosses: Boss
- Notes:
    - Starts the fight with an invisible HP bar. Casts single-target elemental tier-V and -ga tier-IV chosen by the current game day; enfeebling magic is cast regardless of the day.
    - HP-gated moves: 95% Ebullient Nullification (dispels/absorbs all buffs within 20'); 75% Unfaltering Bravado (conal 10,000 damage split among targets, cannot be mitigated by any DT); 65% Chainspell; 60% Dancing Fullers (2,500 AoE within 10' per person in range, including Luopans; unaffected by Sentinel's Scherzo or DT reduction).
    - At 55% Ou levels up and its HP bar shows briefly before hiding again, and it starts using higher-tier magic (single-target shifts to AoE).
    - 45% Zero Hour (AoE magic throat stab, hate reset, 60s Inhibit TP); 30% Target (eyes light up, enabling Eleventh Dimension: a 3:00 Terror on the Target'd player; shifting hate off that player disables it, and Ou gains Interference from this point on).
    - 15% Gardez (AoE Terror within 20' for 3-10s; can be fully resisted with enough magic evasion).
    - At 10% or below: Prophylaxis (instantly drops to 22% HP, then recovers to 100% after 30s unless Ou is killed within that window; using it re-enables every ability it had already used). Kill it fast enough and it may never get to use this.
    - Access: the Omen run initiator must hold all 5 Omen boss beads and ~55+ mobs must be cleared before warping to Ou's floor; all participants lose their Omen boss beads on entry.

- Flags: NM, Aggressive

- Abilities: Afflicting Gaze, Banneret Charge, Besieger's Bane, Dark Arrivisme, Deathly Diminuendo, Diabolic Claw, Enthrall, Hellish Crescendo, Interference, Malign Invocation, Royal Decree, Shadow Wreck, Stygian Sphere, Stygian Cyclone
- Spells: Fire VI, Firaga IV, Firaja, Aero VI, Aeroga IV, Aeroja, Silencega, Stone VI, Stonega IV, Stoneja, Slowga, Water VI, Blizzard VI, Waterga IV, Blizzaga IV, Waterja, Blizzaja, Bindga, Paralyga, Thunder VI, Thundaga IV, Thundaja, Stun, Sleepga
- Zones: Reisenjima (150)
- Content: Geas Fete: Reisenjima: HELM
- Spawn: Forced (examine ??? with Schah's gambit)
- Drops: Takoba, Oranyan, Nzingha Cuirass, Ahosi Leggings
- Image: mobimages/caturae_king.png

    - Spawns alone and begins summoning adds after 30s: 14 total (Bhata x7 = Pawn, Ashva x2 = Knight, Gaja x2 = Bishop, Ratha x2 = Rook, Mantri = Queen), taking ~7 min to summon them all. Only one of each add type is alive at a time (aside from a special second Mantri).
    - Schah gains a considerable damage-taken reduction while two or more adds are alive (scaling with the number alive), so you can hold him with a single add up if your group can sustain it. He casts every spell his adds use, has high Regain, and has all their abilities including Banneret Charge and Enthrall.
    - Unique move Royal Decree: AoE damage that resets all ability timers; unlike Raja's version it does NOT set your subjob to level 0. At high HP Schah himself isn't very threatening and can be held away from the group while a second tank handles adds; he spawns with hate on the popper.
    - Add specials: Bhata (Pawn) - Dark Arrivisme (AoE knockback + dispels 3 buffs); if left alive over 2 min it can transform into a second Mantri. Ashva (Knight) - Banneret Charge (20' AoE, sets HP to 1 and resets hate). Gaja (Bishop) - Besieger's Bane (AoE Bio + Zombie + Terror); weaker, but Stygian Sphere gives it a shield that zeroes magic damage and cuts physical (special-damage abilities like Requiescat/Quick Draw bypass it).
    - Ratha (Rook) - Shadow Wreck (AoE damage + 50% Defense Down, may grant a Dread Spikes-like buff). Mantri (Queen) - Enthrall (AoE Charm, used at or below 50%); relatively magic-resistant (~50% of the damage a Bhata takes). Adds are very resistant to sleep but not immune; time is usually the biggest concern.

- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sight, Magic
- Weak to: Fire +12.5%
- Abilities: Berserk, Dark Wave, Nocturnal Combustion, Penumbral Impact
- Zones: The Eldieme Necropolis [S]
- Spawn: Forced — select the "Shredded Label" at (I-10) on the third map of The Eldieme Necropolis [S] with a Red-labeled crate
- Notes:
    - Assisted by six Dhoul.
    - Does not spawn claimed, and will only attack those in its pseudo-random path up and down the hallways near the "Shredded Label".
    - Trampling attacks appear to be fire-based and can dramatically reduce MP — damage may be proportional to MP taken, or a function of its HP.
    - Like Armed Gears, its elemental susceptibility changes with a TP move, in this case Berserk. Whether it follows a pattern is unknown.
    - Uses a potent area-of-effect Bio TP move.
    - For all intents and purposes untankable — it ignores hate. It tends to stay at the end of the tunnel where the Dhoul are if left alone, but will come down the tunnel every now and then, and will use its bio explosion move if anyone is in front of the "Shredded Label" altar.
    - Hiding behind the "Shredded Label" keeps you out of range of its attacks.
    - Speeds up as its HP drops. A summoner is helpful for both Ellylldan and Dhoul.

> Khrysokhimaira variants (with "Khrysokhimaira" in the name) are less resistant overall and add Lithic Breath (frontal Petrifaction + Weakness).

### Family: Magic Pot

*Ecosystem Arcana · 41 recorded*

> Strong against magic (halves it) and resists every element; no elemental weakness. Break them with Blunt or Hand-to-Hand physical damage (weak to both).
> Possesses Magic Defense Bonus and Double Attack scaled to its RDM/WAR level. Despoil yields a Magic Pot Shard (Magic Defense Down).
> Aggro is by magic: they detect and attack players who use magic nearby.
> Magic Millstones (with "Millstone" in the name) are stylized magic pots found in Pso’Xja; functionally identical.

#### Chest O'Plenty
- Level: 99
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sight, Sound, True Sight, Magic
- Job: Black Mage
- Crystal: Light
- Weak to: Dark +12.5%
- Resists: Slashing -50%, Piercing -50%, H2H -50%, Impact -50%, Light -12.5%
- Abilities: Death Trap, Draw In, Calamitous Collapse, Double Whammy, Slam, Ka-thwack, Booby Prize, Guilded Torpor, Pandora's Gift, Pandora's Curse, Mighty Strikes
- Spells: Death, Absorb-TP
- Zones: Balgas Dais (99); Waughroon Shrine (99); Horlais Peak (99)
- Spawn: Special (failure condition of the A.M.A.N. Trove battlefield)
- Notes:
    - Spawns when the A.M.A.N. Trove battlefield is failed, and uses Ka-thwack immediately — anyone in range without Reraise is KO'd and anyone out of range is drawn in first.
    - Behaves identically to Coffer O'Plenty.
    - Immune to Stun and Silence; Lullaby lands.
    - Four phases, switching at 100%, 69%, 39% and 9% HP. Phase 1 is an ordinary NM fight with its full spell list, physical TP moves and Death Trap. In phase 2 it alternates between two magic-absorption modes, one absorbing all Light-skillchain damage (fire, thunder, wind) and the other all Dark-skillchain damage (ice, water, earth); the switch is triggered by consecutive weapon skills and may be answered with Death Trap. Phase 3 keeps the absorption, takes greatly reduced damage of every type and adds Pandora's Curse and Pandora's Gift. Phase 4 returns to phase-1 damage rules but with a far stronger Ka-thwack.
    - Death Trap is a retaliation for a mistake — healing through the wrong skillchain, or too many skillchains of the same type in a row.
    - Red procs remove its absorption mode; enough damage of the correct element procs blue and strips the aura Ka-thwack leaves behind in phases 1-3.
    - Also casts the -ga III elemental spells and Ancient Magic II.

- Notes:
    - Avatars that appear in certain areas of Temenos: 7 in the Eastern Tower, 7 on Central Temenos 2nd Floor, 6 on Central Temenos 4th Floor.
    - May be any avatar except Diabolos, Alexander and Odin, usually matching the associated elemental.
    - All are susceptible to Stun — even Ramuh and Titan.
    - Can use any of their blood pacts including Astral Flow pacts; damage from those (Tidal Wave, for instance) is blocked by a difference in terrain height, so standing on a ramp above the avatar protects you.
    - Eastern Tower: up to two crates appear per floor, one holding treasure and one holding a Mystic Avatar of that floor’s element — opening the treasure crate makes the avatar crate vanish.
    - Central Temenos 2nd Floor: defeating an elemental turns the elemental weak to it into the matching Mystic Avatar (killing the Fire Elemental replaces the Ice Elemental with Shiva). The zone Mega Boss is a Mystic Avatar (Carbuncle) guarded by two Light Elementals.
    - Central Temenos 4th Floor: summoned by Koo Buzu the Theomanic.

### Family: Avatar

*Ecosystem Avatar · 57 recorded*

> Powerful beings of Vana'diel lore — evoked by Summoners and central to many storylines.
> High-Tier Mission Battlefield Prime Avatars (★) have an innate −30% damage reduction to magic, physical, and ranged, plus a potent en-spell of their element. They have four weaknesses — triggered by Weaponskills, Abilities (e.g. Provoke), offensive Magic, and offensive Pet abilities (Ready/Blood Pact/Wyvern breath/Automaton attachments). Triggering one removes the damage penalty or weakens the en-spell; the effect varies per Prime and per trigger.
> A proc'd weakness stuns the current action and keeps the Prime weakened until it uses Astral Flow, after which it must be re-proc'd.

#### Chaos (NM)
- Flags: NM
- Job: Black Mage / Dark Knight
- Abilities: Manafont, Overrun, Landfall, Wing Buffer, Swooping Assault, Wrenching Impale, Seeping Dread, Oppressive Yawp, Luminous Surge, Tenebrous Surge, Pellucid Surge, Black Sanctus, Sanative Shadow
- Spells: Drain, Impact, Aeroga IV, Thundaga IV, Waterga IV, Absorb-ACC, Meteor, Cure VI, Blinding Fulgor, Scouring Spate, Mighty Guard
- Zones: Gwora-Corridor; Gwora-Throne Room
- Content: Master Trials: Wings of War
- Spawn: Duke Alloces's Decision battlefield (Gwora-Corridor); The Voracious Beast (Gwora-Throne Room).
- Image: mobimages/chaos.png
- Notes:
    - Final boss of The Voracious Beast — a chimera whose purpose is to scour all unworthy life from existence.
    - Duke Alloces's Decision: a weakened Chaos with roughly 180,000 HP and a 15-minute limit. Alter Egos may be called, and you are assisted by Magh Bihu, Dazbog and the Gloom Phantom — if any of them fall, the battlefield ends in failure.
    - The Voracious Beast: roughly 200,000 HP, but it restores to full for phase 2 — about 380,000 HP total, plus whatever Cure VI puts back. 30-minute limit, Alter Egos may be summoned even while engaged. NPC helpers arrive in order: Medada and Gurebu-Ogurebu, Cornelia, Ragelise, Lehko Habhoka, Fickblix, Luzaf.
    - Below roughly 25% HP its HP bar becomes shrouded, it heals to full via Sanative Shadow and gains Black Sanctus. While a Fetter is active Chaos takes 99% less damage from all sources; Fetters hold about 90,000 HP and are very susceptible to skillchain damage.
    - In that final stage it can only be defeated by a finishing blow from a Prime Weapon.
    - Can be stunned and silenced.

### Family: Gnole

*Ecosystem Beast · 16 recorded*

> Attack, Accuracy, Evasion, Attack Speed, and TP-move potency rise with the Moon Phase, peaking at Full Moon.
> Detects by Sight, Sound, and Links while bipedal; Sight only while quadrupedal.
> Normally quadrupeds; stance shifts with level, Moon Phase, and time of day (Lv 76 and below never stand; Lobisons 80-82 go bipedal near Full Moon or when provoked).
> Bipedal: Hand-to-Hand base damage with Monk-like traits (Kick Attacks, Counter), lower attack. Quadrupedal: lower base damage, higher attack.
> A Silver Bullet or Silver Arrow forces the quadrupedal stance.
> Gains Auto-Regen at night.
> Despoil: Gnole Claw (Attack Down).

    - Clear reward unlocks a Magic Defense vorseal.
    - Standard black tiger model (also covers ligers and tigons).

### Family: Yztarg

*Ecosystem Beast · 7 recorded*

> Normal melee is one of three types: a single-target triple attack adding Defense Down (-20%, overwrites Cocoon and similar buffs); a conal/frontal AoE with knockback that reduces player TP; and a conal/frontal AoE with Stun.
> Two color forms with different resistances: White Yztarg (default — strongly resists Earth, no weakness) and Red Yztarg (weak to Water, resists Fire).
> Soulshattering Roar grants the mob a shield that makes it take 0 damage from one physical damage type; remove it with a weapon skill from behind.

## Ecosystem: Beastmen

19 families, 1,729 monsters — Antica, Bugbear, Gigas, Goblin, Lamiae, Mamool Ja, Meeble, Moogle, Orc, Orcish Warmachine, Poroggo, Qiqirn, Quadav, Sahagin, Siege Turret, Tonberry, Troll, Velkk, Yagudo

### Family: Antica

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 67 recorded*

> Ant-like Beastmen of the Altepa deserts and Quicksand Caves. Detect by Sound; drop a Dark Crystal.
> Weak to most elements (Wind especially); resist Earth and Dark. Physical and magical damage taken normally.
> Standard kit: Jamming Wave (AoE Silence), Sandstorm (AoE Blind), Sand Trap (AoE Petrify + hate reset), Sand Shield / Sand Veil (self Def / Eva up), Shoulder Slam (Knockback), Spikeball (Poison), Magnetite Cloud (breath + Weight).
> Typical jobs across the family: Warrior, Black Mage, Paladin, Ranger.

### Family: Bugbear

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 14 recorded*

> Beastmen of the Movalpolos tunnels — Moblin-bred slaves (related to Goblins) with enhanced strength and a transplanted extra brain and eyes. Link with other Bugbears, Moblins and Goblins.
> Detect by Sight and Scent. Night Vision: sight-detection within ~10 yalms / 60-degree cone in darkness (dungeons or nighttime), reduced outdoors during the day. Silence prevents their TP moves.
> Weak to most elements (Light especially); resist Dark. Lightning Crystal; Typical Job Monk.
> Standard kit: Bionic Boost (self Counterstance), Earthshock (AoE phys + Stun), Flying Hip Press (AoE Wind magical damage), Heavy Whisk (cone phys + Knockback), Heavy Blow (single phys).

### Family: Gigas

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 116 recorded*

> Giant Beastmen of Delkfutt's Tower, Qufim, Korroloka, the Movalpolos approaches and the northern glaciers. Link with other Gigas.
> Despoil (Wool Thread / Wool Cloth) inflicts Evasion Down. Detect by Sight; Ice Crystal. Typical jobs: Warrior, Monk, Ranger, Beastmaster.
> Resistances vary by variant. Base Green Gigas and the Jotunn variant (Jotunn Gatekeeper/Hallkeeper/Wallkeeper/Wildkeeper, named Jotunn) are weak to Earth and resist Lightning. The ice variants (Cold/Rime/Sleet/Snow/Blizzard/Frost/Graupel/Hail Gigas, Humbaba) are weak to Fire and resist Ice. The armored variant (Briareus + the Campaign (S) crew) resists all eight elements. A fourth 'Tattooed (Uranos)' all-neutral grid is published but its members are not yet assigned.
> Standard kit: Grand Slam / Trebuchet / Catapult / Power Attack (physical), Impact Roar and Ice Roar (fan-shaped roars), Lightning Roar (magical thunder), Moribund Hack (ice, Paralyze + hate reset), Colossal Blow (enmity reset + Knockback), Mercurial Strike (fixed 111-1111 magical). Some NMs also use Colossal Slam, Mighty Strikes or Familiar.

### Family: Goblin

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 328 recorded*

> Beastmen tribe found across nearly every region of Vana'diel — tinkerers, merchants and mercenaries who fight with an improvised arsenal (bombs, dice, frying pans). Related to the Moblins of Movalpolos; link with other Goblins.
> Detect by Sight and Scent. Fire Crystal. Typical Jobs: Thief, Warrior, Ranger, Dark Knight, Beastmaster, Black Mage, White Mage.
> Weak to every element except Dark (Light especially, +50%); Dark is neutral. Goblins in Dynamis/Divergence take less elemental damage and resist Dark. Moblins resist Dark more (-30%) and are neutral to Earth.
> Bomb Toss can backfire — the goblin drops its bomb, killing itself and dealing damage based on its remaining HP (Bomb Toss (Dropped)). Paralysis Shower, Crispy Candle and Smokebomb can also backfire and then only affect the goblin itself (except in Dynamis).
> Standard Goblin kit: Goblin Rush (3-hit + Knockback), Bomb Toss (Fire AoE, magic accuracy scales with TP), Smokebomb (Dark cone Blind), Crispy Candle (Fire cone). Goblins in Dynamis/Divergence and Wings of the Goddess "Moblin-look" areas additionally use Moblin TP moves — Frypan (AoE + Stun), Paralysis Shower (Ice cone Paralysis) — and Goblin Dice (random effect; Vanguard goblins, Moblin Fantocciniman and the summoned Choplix only).
> Moblin kit: Goblin Rush, Frypan, Paralysis Shower. Despoil: Goblin Chocolate / Goblin Bread (Defense Down), Goblin Stew / Goblin Mushpot (Magic Defense Down).

#### Stabnix Skewerfinger
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sight
- Job: Thief
- Weak to: Light +25%
- Abilities: Bomb Toss, Bomb Toss (Dropped), Crispy Candle, Goblin Rush, Smokebomb
- Zones: North Gustaberg [S]
- Spawn: Quest (Succor to the Sidhe)
- Notes:
    - Roughly 10,000 HP. Immune to sleep. Melee hits land for 100-220 and crit for over 400.
    - Spawned for the quest Succor to the Sidhe, about 15' west of the Watchful Pixie, together with ten Pixie Impalers — it resummons them if they are defeated, heralded by jumping up and down.
    - The Pixie Impalers share its hate and hit for 50-100. Using a weapon skill on any of the NMs makes them use Final Sting, which kills them if it lands; it misses a Paladin under Invincible.
    - It uses Perfect Dodge around 60% HP and the Impalers copy it, then spam Sharp Sting.
    - Goblin Rush hits a Paladin for around 500 and a damage dealer for up to 850.

### Family: Lamiae

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 75 recorded*

> Serpent-bodied Beastmen of the Near East (Aht Urhgan) — the Lamiae. Their aquatic kin the Merrow (and the Nix dancers) share the family; the Gorgon sisters Medusa, Stheno and Euryale are its petrifying elite. Link with other Lamiae.
> Detect by Sight. Water Crystal. Lamiae carry a higher Magic Defense Bonus than most monsters (~110 vs the standard 100; Notorious Monsters often higher still). Typical Jobs: Ranger, Corsair, Summoner, Black Mage, Bard, Samurai, Red Mage.
> Lamia (base) are weak to Fire/Wind/Earth (+15%) and Lightning/Light/Ice (+30%); they resist Water (-40%), Dark (-30%) and Magical (-12.5%). Merrow are weak to Fire/Wind/Earth (+15%) and Lightning (+30%) and strongly resist Water (-50%). Gorgon (Medusa/Stheno) variants have a guaranteed partial resist to every element except — ironically — Earth.
> The kit is weapon/job/type-gated. Universal: Tail Slap (physical cone + Stun). Lamia-only: Hypnotic Sway (single gaze, Amnesia). Merrow-only: Torrent (strips all equipment, water-based). Weapon-gated: Arrow Deluge (Bow), Gusting Gouge (one-handed, Wind damage + Knockback), Pole Swing (Staff), Tidal Slash (Polearm); if a Lamia loses its weapon it uses Hysteric Barrage instead (consumes 5 shadows). Corsair Lamia use Dukkeripen (a random Phantom Roll effect).
> Notorious Monster Lamia add Belly Dance (AoE gaze Charm) and Grim Reaper (physical cone + Doom); NM Merrow add Rising Swell (strips all equipment). Gorgons (Medusa/Stheno) use escalating HNM petrify moves as their HP drops — Petrifaction (single), Calcifying Deluge (long conal petrify + ~600 damage), Gorgon Dance (sight-based AoE petrify within ~20'), Pinning Shot (moderate ranged AoE, 2 shadows). Despoil: Lamian Kaman -1.

### Family: Mamool Ja

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 76 recorded*

> The Mamool Ja are a reptilian Beastmen race of the Near East (Aht Urhgan). They field a broad job spread — Thief, Ninja, Warrior, Dragoon, Blue Mage, White Mage and Black Mage — and yield a Wind Crystal.
> Detects by Sight. Weak to Lightning, Ice (strongest) and Dark; resists Wind.
> Every Mamool Ja uses Somersault Kick (physical + Knockback), Warm-Up (self Accuracy/Evasion Boost) and Firespit — a fire attack that is a 3-hit physical strike for melee jobs (BLU/BST/DRG/NIN/THF) but single-target fire magic for casters (BLM/WHM).
> Beyond the base kit, an individual Mamool Ja uses a job-gated art: Forceful Blow (H2H), Rushing Drub (WHM/BLM), Rushing Slash (BST), Rushing Stab (DRG) or Vorpal Blade (BLU) — all single-target physical. Notorious Monsters can additionally use Groundburst (AoE fire).
> Despoil (THF) on a Mamool Ja can steal a Tariqah -1 and inflicts Defense Down.

#### Lancelord Gaheel Ja
- Level: 80
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sight
- Job: Paladin
- Crystal: Wind
- Weak to: Magical +50%, Ice +15%
- Resists: Fire -40%, Wind -50%, Lightning -40%, Light -15%, Earth -60%, Water -15%
- Abilities: Batterhorn, Clobber, Granite Skin, Fire Angon, Blazing Angon, Burning Memories
- Spells: Protect IV, Shell IV, Cure IV, Flash, Cure V <50%, Protect V <50%, Shell V <50%, Diaga III <50%, Banishga III <50%, Holy, Banish III
- Zones: Jade Sepulcher
- Drops: Bestas Bane, Savas Jawshan, Sifahir Slacks, Sahip Helm, Pratik Earring, Seraphicaller
- Image: mobimages/lancelord gaheel ja.png
- Notes:
    - Puppet in Peril II — fought in the Jade Sepulcher with a Puppet In Peril phantom gem (Aht Urhgan Mission 29). The fight opens with several low-HP Mamool Ja (Polemicist/BLM, Isangoma/WHM, Flamerearer/DRG, Unseen/NIN, Profligate/THF), all susceptible to Sleep; the Flamerearer can Call Wyvern even while slept or petrified. Lancelord Gaheel Ja spawns once every add is dead.
    - Casts Protect IV and Shell IV on itself; once those are dispelled it prioritizes Cure and Flash. It has very high defense — rely on magic damage (Formless Strikes is ineffective; Runes are effective). It also has a normal ranged attack for out-of-range targets.
    - At 50% HP it gains Cure V / Protect V / Shell V / Banishga III / Diaga III and swaps Fire Angon for Blazing Angon. At 25% it swaps to Burning Memories, which it favors — that TP move is fairly easy to Stun.

### Family: Meeble

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 14 recorded*

> Beastmen tribe encountered as enemies during Meeble Burrows expeditions (Ghoyu's Reverie, Ruhotz Silvermines, Everbloom Hollow); certain members (e.g. Meeble Augur, Meeble Scribe) are non-hostile NPCs. Monk-type, Earth Crystal.
> All are MNK-type and can Guard and Counter physical attacks; while passive they may sit down and fall asleep, and asleep Meebles will not aggro or link.
> Detect by Sound (and True Sound). Weak to Fire, Ice, Earth, Lightning and Light (+15%); resist Water (-40%); no physical resistances.
> Base kit: Drill Claw (conal, Max HP Down -75% + Knockback), Thrashing Assault (5-hit + Defense Down), Meeble Warble (AoE call that links awake Meebles, Damage + Silence). Puncturing Frenzy (conal physical) is Notorious Monster only.

### Family: Moogle

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 3 recorded*

> Beastmen descended from the fallen Kingdom of Kupalika. The great majority of the Moogle bestiary category are non-hostile service NPCs (Nomad, Porter, Curio Vendor, Greeter, Dealer, etc.) and are not tracked here as combat mobs.
> No published Crystal, detection, or resistance data for the family. Typical jobs across members: Warrior, Monk, Thief, White Mage, Red Mage and Black Mage.
> The combat-relevant member tracked here is Bozzetto Voyager Moogle (Ambuscade).

#### Bozzetto Voyager Moogle

### Family: Orc

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 250 recorded*

> Orcs are the Beastmen of the San d'Oria (Ronfaure) region; related to the Orcish Warmachine siege engines they build.
> Detect by Sight (not True-Sight).
> Base (Green Orc & Overlord) resistances: neutral to Fire and Ice; weak to Water (+50%) and to Wind/Lightning/Light/Earth/Dark (+30%); no physical resistance.
> Dark Orcs (Dynamis) shift the grid: resist Fire and Ice (-15%), weak to Water (+30%) and the other elements (+15%).
> Armored Orcs (Wings of the Goddess [S] areas) are heavily elemental-resistant: Fire/Ice -50%, Wind/Lightning/Light/Earth/Dark -30%, Water neutral. A leather-mask Campaign variant shares these Armored values.
> Beyond the base kit, Orcs gain restricted moves by context: Orcish Counterstance (WotG areas only); and, for Notorious Monsters only, Berserker Dance, Fanatic Dance, Shoulder Charge, and Tornado Edge (WotG/Dynamis).
> Despoil: Meat Jerky, Dhalmel Steak, and Buffalo Jerky (Attack Down).

- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sight
- Job: Red Mage / Beastmaster

- Weak to: Water +25%
- Abilities: Howl, Arm Block, Battle Dance, Shoulder Attack, Slam Dunk, Aerial Wheel, Veil of Chaos, Chainspell

- Zones: Batallia Downs [S]
- Spawn: Quest (Succor to the Sidhe)
- Notes:
    - Accompanied by five pet tigers; if they are killed he eventually summons new ones.
    - Very high HP, but easy to tank so long as you do not feed him TP. His pets sleep, but not for long.
    - The fight is confined to a 50-foot radius from the top of the hill at (F-7) — leaving it drops you from the battle with no way back in.
    - Buffs carry in; no cures from outside the party, and outside monsters and -ga spells cannot reach you.
    - If the party wipes, the mobs return to the hilltop and despawn after two minutes.

- Abilities: Aerial Wheel, Arm Block, Battle Dance, Howl, Shoulder Attack, Slam Dunk, Veil of Chaos, Berserker Dance
- Spells: Fire IV, Blizzard IV, Aero IV, Stone IV, Thunder III, Thunder IV, Water IV, Firaga III, Blizzaga III, Aeroga III, Thundaga III, Waterga III, Flare, Freeze, Tornado, Quake, Burst, Flood, Poisonga, Poisonga II, Bio III, Burn, Frost, Choke, Rasp, Shock, Drown, Drain, Aspir, Blaze Spikes, Stun, Blind, Bind, Sleep II, Sleepga II
- Zones: Vunkerl Inlet [S]
- Spawn: Spawned at the Underbrush at (F-13) for the quest The Price of Valor
- Notes:
    - Roughly 11,000 HP.
    - Normally casts tier IV magic and tier III -aga spells for around 900 damage. Tier IV spells are absorbed by shadows, and the tier III -agas can easily be stunned.
    - After using Berserker Dance it gains a large amount of Fast Cast, close to Chainspell, and starts casting Dispelga, Blindga and Sleepga II — but stops using tier III -agas for the duration.
    - Its melee attacks carry a very potent additional effect, Curse, which halves both MP and HP.
    - Slow and Paralyze land easily.

### Family: Orcish Warmachine

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 13 recorded*

> Beastmen war machines built and operated by the Orcs (Related: Orc). Warrior-type, Fire Crystal. Detect by Sight (plus Scent; some have True Sight); the "Night Vision" trait widens aggro range at night.
> Weak to Fire (+59%, flammable) and to Ice, Wind, Lightning, Water and Light (+30%); resist Earth (-50%) and Dark (-50%).
> Base kit: Blastbomb (frontal fire + Bind), Burst (single physical), Fire Arrow (single fire), Firebomb (AoE fire), Fountain (frontal water). NM-only moves: Scatter Shell (~1000 physical split among targets, long cast), Sticky Grenade (AoE physical + Weight), Tear Grenade (AoE physical + Silence + Blind).
> Despoil yields Meat Jerky / Dhalmel Steak / Buffalo Jerky (Attack Down). Cogtooth Skagnogg steps through its kit by HP% and only uses the three grenade/shell moves below 20%; Kegpaunch Doshgnosh is immune to Bind, Gravity and Sleep.

### Family: Poroggo

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 30 recorded*

> Poroggo are frog Beastmen: enlarged, bipedal toads created by the frog princess Samariri's magic, who later joined the Mamool Ja Savages. Related to the Frog family.
> Typical job Black Mage (sub Bard); Water Crystal.
> Detect by True Sound (true-hearing - they aggro through Sneak) and pursue by Scent. Sneak/Invisible do not hide you; the Mamool Ja costume from the Viscous Liquid ??? avoids their hearing.
> Very high magic defense. Base (Green) grid: strong to Water -80%, Light -70%, Ice -30%, Earth -15%; weak only to Lightning +15%; neutral to Fire/Wind/Dark. No physical resistance.
> Ariri Samariri (red) and Brekekekex (blue) variants share an identical, much heavier all-element grid: Water -95%, Light -80%, Ice -50%, Earth -40%, Fire/Wind/Dark -30%, Lightning -15%, plus a minor (~25%) resistance to one physical damage type.
> Base kit: Frog Cheer (self Magic Attack Bonus), Frog Song (single-target Charm), Magic Hammer (damage + MP Drain), Providence (self Haste, then casts Breakga/Graviga/Slowga/Bindga/Death), and Water Bomb (AoE Water damage + Silence). As Black Mages they also cast Waterga I-V, Slow, Addle, and the usual -ga nukes.
> Gated moves: Frog Chorus (AoE Charm - Notorious Monsters only) and Quenching Hammer (AoE damage + full Dispel + Aspir, scaling with the target's buff count - Ambuscade only).
> Despoil: Poroggo Hat (Magic Attack Down).

### Family: Qiqirn

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 34 recorded*

> Qiqirn are ratlike Beastmen of the Near East (Treasures of Aht Urhgan): scavengers, merchants, diggers, and treasure-hunters spread across the Alzadaal ruins, Aydeewa, Caedarva Mire, and the Arrapago/Halvung frontier.
> Typical jobs Thief and Black Mage; many field adversaries are Ranger. Earth Crystal.
> Detect by Sight and Sound (some NMs use the True variants - e.g. Cheese Hoarder Gigiroon detects by Sound). Qiqirn are not a Scent family.
> Resistances: strong only to Earth -30%; weak to Wind +30% and to Fire/Light/Ice/Water +15%; neutral to Lightning and Dark. No physical resistance.
> Base kit: Cutpurse (removes one equipment piece), Deadeye (conal Defense Down + Magic Def Down), Faze (sight-based Terror), Kibosh (Amnesia), and Sandspray (conal Blindness + Accuracy Down -100).
> Strap Cutter (removes/disables 3-5 equipment slots at once) is used by Notorious Monsters only.

### Family: Quadav

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 237 recorded*

> Family has -5% Max HP compared to other mobs.
> Despoil steals: Herb Crawler Eggs (Evasion Down) or Hard-boiled Egg (Defense Down).
> Standard (Brown) Quadav resist nothing and are weak to most magic (Lightning most of all). Dynamis (Grey), Armored [S], and Khroma variants progressively resist Fire and Water and blunt those magic weaknesses; Khroma Quadav strongly resist every element.
> Gated abilities: Wrath of Gu'Dha (Dynamis & Campaign NMs), Diamond Shell (Wings of the Goddess / Campaign — nullifies physical damage from behind), Ore Lob (Campaign NMs and most Beadeaux [S] NMs), Skull Smash and Shell Charge (certain NMs).

    - Like the other five quadavs in the battle he casts magic tied to one element — Aa'Bho uses Fire.
    - Casts progressively stronger spells as the other quadavs die: tier 4s, then Ancient Magic II, then -aga III, then an enfeeble-ga or enhancing-ga.
    - Casts Dispelga as its enfeeble-ga.
    - One of six Quadav that spawn together for the quest Succor to the Sidhe: Aa'Bho Slashburner, Bo'Gha Winterkill, Du'Vha Grimewind, Ea'Zhu Tremorcrag, Gi'Rho Wrathstorm and He'Dho Spatesurge.
    - Each of the six casts magic tied to one specific element.
    - Casts progressively stronger spells as the others die — starting at the Tier IV spells, then Ancient Magic II, then -aga III, then an enfeebling or enhancing -ga.
    - Aa'Bho uses Fire magic.
    - Casts Dispelga as its enfeebling -ga.

### Family: Sahagin

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 53 recorded*

> Sahagin are amphibious fish Beastmen of the Elshimo seas - Sea Serpent Grotto, the jungles, and the Mamool Ja-held waters. Typical jobs Dragoon, Monk, White Mage, and Bard; Water Crystal.
> Detect by Sound only.
> Resistances: strong to Water -50%; weak to Lightning +50%, Ice +30%, Wind +15%, Earth +15%; neutral to Fire, Light, Dark.
> Base kit: Bubble Armor (dispelable Shell, ~-20% magic damage taken), Hydroball (AoE Water damage + STR Down, scaling with the target's level), Hydro Shot (ranged physical + Knockback + Enmity reset), and Spinning Fin (AoE damage + Stun). Jumping Thrust (single-target, Jump-like) is used only by Dragoon Sahagin.
> Notorious Monsters use their job's SP ability: Bard NMs (Denn/Fyuu/Seww) use Soul Voice, White Mage NMs (Meww/Novv) use Benediction, and Dragoon NMs (Mouu) use Call Wyvern - the summoned Sahagin's Wyvern does not despawn when the NM dies.
> Despoil: Quus, Coral Butterfly (Magic Defense Down).

### Family: Siege Turret

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 4 recorded*

> Siege Turrets are stationary siege engines built by the three Beastmen nations; they appear in Campaign as Orcish, Quadav, and Yagudo Turrets.
> In Campaign they have +50 Magic Defense (150 total).
> The wiki lists no detection, no crystal, no job, and an empty TP-move set - they are passive emplacements. Each turret has its own resist profile.
> All three take -50% Magical damage. Orcish Turret: strong to Fire/Ice -50%, Wind/Lightning/Light/Earth/Dark -30%, Water neutral. Quadav Turret: Fire/Water -50%, Lightning -15%, Wind/Light/Ice/Earth/Dark -30%. Yagudo Turret: Wind/Ice -50%, Light -15%, Fire/Lightning/Earth/Water/Dark -30%.

### Family: Tonberry

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 72 recorded*

> Resistances are consistent across all Tonberry variants (Green, Yellow, Purple); individual Notorious Monsters may differ.
> Despoil steals: Poison Flour (Magic Defense Down), Poison Dust, or Venom Dust.
> Everyone's Grudge / Everyone's Rancor scale with the target's "Tonberry Hate" (Tonberries killed); Throat Stab cuts HP to ~5% and wipes enmity.
