### Family: Troll

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 76 recorded*

> Despoil steals Jadagna -1 (Attack Down).
> Gurfurlur (King Troll) strongly resists every element (Fire/Lightning/Ice/Earth ~75%, Light/Dark ~50%, Wind/Water ~30%) and two physical damage types (~33% and 50% in the physical row — columns not yet identified, so not stamped per-mob).
> Overthrow and Rock Smash are used only when the Troll is unarmed; Potent Lunge only when it holds a weapon.
> Gated abilities: Zarbzan (Ranger Trolls), Drop Hammer / Hammerblow / Hammer-Go-Round / Seismohammer (Hammer Trolls — a weapon-model variant, not identifiable by name so kept to notes), Healing Stomp (Notorious Monsters), and Arcane Stomp / Haymaker / Head Snatch / Incessant Fists / Pleiades Ray / Sledgehammer (King Trolls only).

### Family: Velkk

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 33 recorded*

> The Velkk are a Beastman tribe of Ulbuka, found mostly in southeast Marjami Ravine and in Ulbuka field zones.
> Two types by garb/equipment: Warrior-type (red garb, Voay Sword — Warrior/Dark Knight) and Mage-type (blue garb, Voay Staff — Black Mage/Red Mage).
> Despoil steals Velkk Necklace (Magic Defense Down) or Velkk Mask (Defense Down).
> Type-gated abilities: Saurian Slide (Warrior-type), Saurian Swamp (Mage-type), Jungle Wallop (NM Warrior-type only), Jungle Hoodoo (NM Mage-type only).

#### Bozzetto Regent
- Flags: NM
- Job: Paladin
- Resists: Fire -50%, Wind -50%, Lightning -30%, Light -50%, Ice -30%, Earth -50%, Water -80%, Dark -70%
- Abilities: Coming Through, Croctastrophe, Galumph, Merciless Mauling, Velkkan Ambush, Nobless Oblige, Sovereign's Edict
- Spells: Banish II, Cure IV, Flash, Protect IV, Shell IV
- Zones: Maquette Abdhaljs-Legion
- Spawn: Ambuscade battlefield (Maquette Abdhaljs-Legion); entry requires Ambuscade Primer Volume One.
- Notes:
    - Auto-attacks carry an en-Bind effect.
    - Assisted by a Bozzetto Servitor.
    - Merciless Mauling's weapon-removal effect does not occur when the Bozzetto Regent uses it.
    - Appeared in Ambuscade in February 2017 and October 2018.

#### Brash Gramk-Droog
- Flags: NM
- Job: Warrior
- Resists: Fire -50%, Wind -50%, Lightning -30%, Light -50%, Ice -30%, Earth -50%, Water -80%, Dark -70%
- Abilities: Battle Trance, Coming Through, Croctastrophe, Galumph, Mighty Strikes, Merciless Mauling, Velkkan Ambush
- Zones: Cirdas Caverns [U]
- Spawn: Incursion battlefield (Cirdas Caverns [U]); entry requires a Velkk fetish.
- Drops: Tsoa. Crossbow, Gavialis Helm, Mekosu. Harness, Globidonta Ring
- Notes:
    - Auto-attacks carry an en-Bind effect.
    - Susceptible to sleep but will resist it; light-based sleeps land more reliably.
    - Uses Mighty Strikes at 95~80%, 70~55% and 45~30% HP.
    - Uses Battle Trance a set number of times per Incursion level — 1 at 123-124, 2 at 125-126, 3 at 127-128, 4 at 129-130, 5 at 131-132, 6 at 133+. It will not use Battle Trance while Mighty Strikes is active.
    - Also drops Gramk-Droog's coffer and grand coffer, and the Gramk-Droog's circlet key item.
    - Grants the title Suchian Feller.

### Family: Yagudo

*Ecosystem Beastmen · 234 recorded*

> The Yagudo are the birdlike Beastman tribe of the Windurst region (Castle Oztroja / Giddeus / Sarutabaruta).
> Multiple resistance profiles by variant: base Yagudo; Dark Yagudo (Dynamis); Armored Yagudo [S]; Campaign NMs / White Yagudo [S]; and Tzee Xicu the Manifest each have their own grid.
> White Yagudo (e.g. Yagudo Genja, Soo Luma the Ascended in the Shadowreign era) have +30 / +33 extra Magic Defense respectively.
> Despoil steals Roast Carp / Roast Pipira (Attack Down), Boiled Tuna Head or Sole Sushi (Accuracy Down) — Castle Oztroja [S] only.
> Gated abilities (Notorious Monster / Dynamis / Campaign only): Doom, Feathered Furore, Dark Invocation, Shirahadori.

#### Gessho
- Level: 68-80
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Ninja
- Crystal: Wind
- Weak to: Ice +25%
- Abilities: Hane Fubuki, Happobarai, Hiden Sokyaku, Rinpyotosha, Shibaraku, Shiko no Mitate, Kagedourou, Karakuridourou, Tsujikaze, Kamaitachi, Mijin Gakure
- Spells: Katon: San, Hyoton: San, Huton: San, Doton: San, Raiton: San, Suiton: San, Utsusemi: San, Jubaku: Ni, Hojo: San, Kurayami: San, Dokumori: San, Katon: Ni, Hyoton: Ni, Huton: Ni, Doton: Ni, Raiton: Ni, Suiton: Ni, Utsusemi: Ni, Hojo: Ni, Kurayami: Ni, Dokumori: Ni
- Zones: Talacca Cove
- Image: mobimages/gessho.png
- Notes:
    - ★Legacy of the Lost — spawned by Aht Urhgan Mission 35 in Talacca Cove. Mixes ranged and melee attacks.
    - Above 50% HP it casts Utsusemi: Ni, elemental ninjutsu at the :ni tier, and :ichi debuffs. Below 50% it upgrades to Utsusemi: San, :san elemental ninjutsu, and :ni debuffs, and begins using Mijin Gakure.
    - Kagedourou (above 50%) and Karakuridourou (below 50%) summon multiple clones. Below 50%, every clone — Gessho included — is masked and invulnerable except the one “correct” clone; deal enough damage to it and the rest depop so the fight resumes. This happens more often under 25%.
    - Below 50% it also gains Tsujikaze (AoE magic + Silence / Defense Down / Magic Defense Down, ~14.9′) and Kamaitachi (AoE physical + major Knockback + Dispel all; the dispel can be avoided by a shield block or Utsusemi).

## Ecosystem: Bird

12 families, 375 monsters — Amphiptere, Apkallu, Bat, Cockatrice, Colibri, Flock Bat, Greater Bird, Harpeia, Hippogryph, Lesser Bird, Tulfaires, Waktza

### Family: Amphiptere

*Ecosystem Bird · 12 recorded*

> Fly in the sky and descend on players when detecting them.
> Can detect and aggro low HP despite not being undead.
> Possess Triple Attack and +20 (120) Magic Defense despite being a WAR/BLM. The red Sanguiptere subspecies have +50 (150) Magic Defense across all examples.
> Amphiptere in Beaucedine Glacier [S] and Xarcabard [S] have a 30 minute respawn time.
> Builds sleep and bind resistance — sleep resistance building more rapidly, after only a few casts.

### Family: Apkallu

*Ecosystem Bird · 17 recorded*

> Apkallu within Treasures of Aht Urhgan areas have a ZONE-WIDE enmity system — killing them raises "Apkallu Hate" for that zone, which diminishes slowly over time. This does not apply to Apkallu outside ToAU, such as in Abyssea. Each zone has its own Apkallu enmity.
> As Apkallu Hate rises their behaviour changes: they start with Yawn as their only TP move and upgrade to more aggressive ones such as Beak Lunge (and stop using Yawn once they reach Wing Slap); they become aggressive towards players who walk by where they are normally passive; their damage reduces until it is nearly nothing; their double attack and counter rates increase; enmity becomes erratic as they switch to any player casting magic, even if the spell is not completed; and at the final stage they run away like Qiqirns to link their friends.
> It is unknown how the NPC Apkallu function. They can be fed by trading large fish (such as Ahtapot or Veydal Wrasse), but not all accept fish and the size may matter. When accepting a fish they follow the player around, though the implications are unclear. The NPC can change into a normal foe if enough Apkallu are defeated.
> The Inguza are a subspecies of Apkallu once thought extinct, but recently rediscovered at Marjami Ravine in the East Ulbuka Territory.
> Despoil: Apkallu Feather (Evasion Down), Apkallu Egg (Slow).

#### Tiyanak
- Level: 122
- Flags: NM, Links
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Warrior
- Crystal: Wind
- Weak to: Piercing +25%, Ranged +25%, Fire +30%, Wind +50%, Lightning +30%, Light +50%, Ice +15%, Earth +30%, Water +30%
- Resists: Dark -70%
- Abilities: Blood Drain, Marrow Drain, Soul Accretion, Subsonics, Ultrasonics
- Spells: Dread Spikes, Endark
- Zones: Misareaux Coast (122)
- Content: Unity: Wanted: Wanted 2
- Spawn: Unity NM (1,800 Unity Accolades) — spawn at an Ethereal Junction at (G-8), (F-8) or (I-11)
- Drops: Tiyanak's Coffer, Tiyanak's Fang, Lugra Cloak, Lugra Cloak +1, Lugra Earring, Lugra Earring +1
- Image: mobimages/bat.png
- Notes:
    - Has Double Attack, Triple Attack, and varying Endark from 80-300. Frequently casts Dread Spikes.
    - Blood Drain regularly does 1k to non-tanks. Below 25% HP it uses Soul Accretion almost exclusively.
    - Light damage during a WS or magic procs blue !! or white !!; the proc seems to remove Dread Spikes. Light-based WS proc blue, as does Holy II. Quite weak on Lightsday.
    - NO Supersonics, consistent with the ToAU-only gate (Misareaux Coast is a CoP zone).

### Family: Colibri

*Ecosystem Bird · 19 recorded*

> Colibri are officially labeled as "hummingbirds" despite behaving like parrots (mimic magic) and having a beak like a toucan's — likely for their rapid hummingbird wing movement, and because "colibri" means hummingbird in Romanian.
> Colibri can reflect White Magic, Black Magic, Songs and Ninjutsu back at players, but not Blue Magic. Not all colibri can reflect — Lesser Colibri and the ones in Sheol C are exceptions.
> Colibri have the traits of a Red Mage, which means increased Magic Attack Bonus and Magic Defense Bonus.
> Snatch Morsel is resistible with magic evasion and fire resistance+. You need a fire resistance value greater than 0, no matter your magic evasion level.
> Despoil: Colibri Feather (Evasion Down), Colibri Beak (Attack Down).

- Zones: Mamook
- Spawn: Voidwatch (Amber stratum abyssite + Voidstone)
- Drops: Ereptor Lance, Gardyloo Trousers, C.Abjuration: Hn., F.Abjuration: Hn., Riftsand, Crystal Petrifact
- Image: mobimages/colibri.png
- Notes:
    - Voidwatch Path: Amber I. Rift locations (I-7), (J-8), (L-8).
    - Assisted by up to six Predatory Colibri, summoned one at a time with each Snatch Morsel; once all six are out no more spawn. They use Pecking Flurry, Feather Tickle and Snatch Morsel, each casts only one spell repeatedly (Comet, Holy, Meteor or one -ja spell), and each has around 20,000 HP.
    - Snatch Morsel causes Yalungur to level up if food was stolen from the target.
    - Under 50% HP it also casts Horde Lullaby II and gains access to Wisecrack (a long-duration 10' AoE Charm, up to 2 minutes) — Stunning recommended. If all players are charmed it despawns.
    - Tropic Tenor is its unique TP move: ~1k in a 15' AoE, knockback, and lowers all attributes.
    - Also drops Level 86-99 spell scrolls, various crafting materials, and the Atmacite of the Tropics and Dusky periapt of concentration key items.

### Family: Flock Bat

*Ecosystem Bird · 63 recorded*

> Related family: Bat.
> Two of the four standard TP moves are area-gated: Slipstream and Turbulence are CoP/ToAU areas only. Bats in the base-game areas have only Jet Stream and Sonic Boom.
> Knife Edge Circle and Train Fall are not part of the standard kit. Only Tres Duendes is known to use them (its second and third forms).
> Despoil: Bat Wing (Accuracy Down), Beastman Blood and other bloods (Evasion Down).

### Family: Greater Bird

*Ecosystem Bird · 38 recorded*

> Typical job: Warrior, White Mage, or Black Mage; typical sub: Warrior, Bard, or Red Mage.
> Greatly resist dark-based sleeps, but light-based sleeps are not resisted.
> Despoil: Giant Bird Feather (Accuracy Down).
> NMs and the Gagana subtype swap their ordinary TP moves for enhanced versions: Gliding Spike becomes Dread Dive, Scratch becomes Blind Vortex, Triple Attack becomes Giga Scream, and Stormwind becomes Dread Wind. Feather Barrier is shared by both sets. The swap is per-move, not all-or-nothing - Suzaku keeps Stormwind, and Kreutzet, Gandji, Langmeidong and Zacatzontli use the standard set outright.

Resistant to Silence but still susceptible to it. Will use Chainspell once. 88-90 in Ru'Aun Gardens, 83-84 when Kirin summons it at The Shrine, 112 M.DEF.

Title: Suzaku Plucker; drops Shukuyunoibuki, Shukuyukama, Shukuyu Sune-Ate and Shukuyu Ring.
    - Red-and-teal plumage: the Sky god Suzaku, the Vermilion Bird of the South. Physical resistance is milder than the base roc's (-12.5% rather than -25%), but Fire and Ice are near-immune and the elemental weakness moves to Water.

- Notes:

    - Stormwind covers a large area (~22') and applies Silence; Dread Wind covers a similar area and applies a 15 second Terror. Ice elemental damage, or a magic burst for the blue proc, reduces or removes those added effects.
    - Distract overrides its Feather Barrier.
    - Black roc model with a purple beak and legs (Zduhac). Identical to the base roc except the Ice weakness is +30% rather than +50%.
    - Groups the Gagana subtype with the NMs: both swap their TP moves for the enhanced versions.

### Family: Hippogryph

*Ecosystem Bird · 24 recorded*

> THIS FAMILY BREAKS THE BIRD PIERCING RULE. Its grid row 1 is 100% across all eight — no physical weakness and no physical resist. General Notes say it outright: they do not take bonus damage from piercing. Every other Bird family is Piercing/Ranged +25%.
> Killing one grants a 15% experience point bonus.
> Can be Aspired.
> Despoil: Hippogryph Tailfeather (Evasion Down) or Hippogryph Feather (Accuracy Down).
> Trait: Movement Speed +?%.
> Hoof Volley is used by Notorious Monsters only.

#### Ongo
- Level: 134
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sight
- Resists: Fire -75%, Earth -70%, Dark -75%

    - Odyssey NM. Level 134, Magic Defense 100. Title: Ongo Obliterator. Clearing it lets players purchase the Agwu's equipment. Assisted by Ongo's Tulfaire.
    - Fire 25%, Earth 30%, Dark 25%.
    - Starts with a significant -Damage Taken status. The damage window has to be opened with procs, consistently: Crashing Thunder triggers the red !! weakness, spawns fetters and opens the window for a blue; magic-bursting Earth then triggers the blue !!, removes the fetters and closes the red window. Two bursts are needed in the same skillchain step the first time, three the second, and so on.
    - Earth is resisted at 30% — the burst is a proc trigger, not a damage weakness.
    - The fetters apply Shock at roughly 150 HP/tick. As with the Wildskeeper Reive and Delve variants the Shock does not wear off on death — keep a Panacea ready or Erase it.
    - The fetters deal magic damage at a fast interval but do not hit hard. Most of the damage comes from the Shock DoT or unresisted Elemental spells.
    - At Vengeance 20 an extra monster, Ongo's Tulfaire, spawns when the boss hits 75% HP.
    - Vengeance 20 guidance: melee accuracy ~1,241; effective magic accuracy for Stone spells ~1,365.
    - Base 345 INT at Vengeance 0, +4 per tier (405 at V15, 425 at V20). Base DT 0% at Vengeance 0, +1% per tier.
    - Uses Elemental Sforzo at 75% HP.
    - Its own ability table gates Static Prison to HP <50%.

The count scales with its remaining HP: 2 at 100-76%, 3 at 75-51%, 4 at 50-26%, 5 at 25-11%, 6 at 10-1%. They initially target whoever spawned Palila, and use a TP move in tandem with it — their Damnation Dive has a potent stun. They are susceptible to sleep, repose and lullaby.
    - Crashing Thunder gives it an aura: increased evasion, a potent regain, and Avoidance Down on players, which prevents parrying and blocking with a shield. The aura also grants three extra TP moves — Static Prison, Weighted Flux and Spark Storm.
    - Earth damage (including Tellus) and its associated skillchains have a chance to proc the blue !!, terrorize Palila and remove the aura.
    - Rewards also include a DEX/AGI Vorseal.

### Family: Demon

*Ecosystem Demon · 126 recorded*

> Moves at roughly 150% of normal speed (Increased Movement Speed).
> Typical jobs: Warrior, Dark Knight, Black Mage, Summoner.
> Comes in Black and Red variants. Black Demons are weak to Light (~+30%) and take normal damage from other elements; Red Demons are weak to Light (~+15%) but resist all other elements (~-15%). Both resist Magic damage (~-25%).
> Standard TP moves: Demonic Howl, Hecatomb Wave, Soul Drain. Some members add restricted moves: Condemnation (Dark Kindred), Hellborn Yawp (Shadowsoul/Abununnu/Count Bifrons), Quadrastrike.

- Level: 99

- Resists: Fire -15%, Wind -15%, Lightning -15%, Light -15%, Ice -15%, Earth -15%, Water -15%, Dark -15%
- Abilities: Transfusion, Manastrom, Tera Slash, Violent Rupture, Oblivion Smash, Dynamic Assault, Dynamic Implosion
- Spells: Sleepga, Breakga, Death

- Spawn: Forced (trade Fiendish Tome: Chapters 26-30 to ??? near Castle Zvahl entrance) (E-8)

- Notes:
    - Spawns via forced pop in Dynamis - Xarcabard; defeating it does NOT grant a time extension.
    - Has the one-hour abilities Chainspell, Blood Weapon, Hundred Fists, and Mighty Strikes. Immune to Silence.
    - Casts Tier III AoE elemental spells plus Sleepga and Breakga; at lower HP casts Tier IV AoE elementals and Death.
    - After ~45s it splits into clones, one of which is the real Arch Dynamis Lord (all clones share the original’s HP%). Clone count is set by its HP when it splits: above 40% HP makes 2 clones, below 40% makes 3.
    - Kill the real clone to end the fight; taking too long (~another 45s) lets it split again. Clone spawns sometimes force melees to disengage. Ramuh’s Shock Squall is very effective, stunning all clones for up to ~10s.

### Family: Dvergr

*Ecosystem Demon · 16 recorded*

> Detect by sound only (blind).
> Most Dvergr NMs carry a large Magic Defense Bonus (~+30-50) and very high INT. Apex Powercrazed Dvergr have neutral Magic Defense but the highest INT (455) of any non-NM foe in the game.
> Standard TP moves: Bilgestorm, Cackle, Hellsnap, Hellclap, Necrobane, Necropurge, Thundris Shriek. Naphula and Fjalar also use Dunur Strike (strips equipment) and Bilrost Squall (random-element AoE + enfeebles).

    - Phase I – Four Chariots (lv119): Salvage moves incl. Brainjack (charm), Discoid (high split AoE), Homing Missile (90% current-HP AoE), Mortal Revolution (AoE stun).

Phase IV – Dvergr (lv145): Astral Flow at 74/49/24/4%, casts Aspir/Drain/Meteor and tier V/VI nukes; almost fully resistant to Finale/Elegy without Troubadour.

### Family: Gallu

*Ecosystem Demon · 6 recorded*

> Attacks count as abilities rather than normal melee swings (Melees are Abilities trait): they get TP-move treatment, cannot be countered, occur even with no players nearby, and are prevented by Silence.
> Three melee attacks: Triple Punch (single-target 3-hit), Claw Swipe (conal, +Stun), Ground Punch (AoE, +Bind).
> Shared elemental TP kit, one move per element: Bolt of Perdition (Lightning), Crippling Rime (Ice), Diluvial Wake (Water), Divesting Gale (Wind), Kurnugi Collapse (Earth), Searing Halitus (Fire), Oblivion’s Mantle (Dark, 10-count Doom).
> Two models (Purple / White Gallu) with identical resistances except Breath (Purple -62.5%, White -25%); NO subtype — grid assigned per mob by model.

### Family: Gargouille

*Ecosystem Demon · 22 recorded*

> Alternates between standing and flying modes (~every 3+ minutes; lands again after waiting or taking enough damage; some NMs switch modes after a set amount of damage). Gains +60 Evasion while flying, and certain NMs (e.g. Wasserspeier) avoid all melee attacks while flying.
> Available TP moves change with mode: standing -> Bloody Claw, Terror Eye, Triumphant Roar; flying -> Dark Orb, Dark Mist. Shadow Burst is NM-only, below 50% HP.
> Despoil yields Gargouille Eye (Accuracy Down), Gargouille Horn (Attack Down), or Gargouille Shank (Magic Defense Down).

### Family: Imp

*Ecosystem Demon · 43 recorded*

> An imp's horn can be broken with critical hits or a weapon skill that deals critical damage; the horn regrows after a time.
> Without its horn an imp cannot use Abrasive Tantara or Deafening Tantara, and resorts to Frenetic Rip.
> With its horn intact an imp resists more (Wind 60%, Dark 20%, and neutral to Lightning/Ice/Earth/Water); once the horn is broken it opens up to Fire/Lightning/Light/Ice/Earth/Water weakness while its Wind and Dark resistance eases.
> Despoil yields an Imp Wing (Accuracy Down).

### Family: Macuil

*Ecosystem Demon · 4 recorded*

> Regular attacks are one of three abilities (Melees are Abilities): Gust (Wind — Choke ~-18 HP/tic + knockback, passes through shadows), Lightning (shock ~-18 HP/tic + Stun, removes all shadows), and a 3-hit Triple Attack (absorbed by three shadows).
> Its hands carry an elemental aura (Wind or Thunder) that sets which TP moves it can use and shifts its resistances: Wind hand -> Chokehold, Tearing Gust, Shrieking Gale; Thunder hand -> Zap, Concussive Shock, Undulating Shockwave.
> Macuil's Shrieking Gale is Wind damage + knockback (the shared ability entry shows the Harpeia Dispel variant).

#### Gartell
- Level: 145
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Job: Monk / Black Mage
- Resists: Fire -95%, Wind -95%, Lightning -95%, Light -95%, Ice -95%, Earth -95%, Water -95%, Dark -95%
- Abilities: Chokehold, Concussive Shock, Shrieking Gale, Tearing Gust, Undulating Shockwave, Zap
- Zones: Outer Ra'Kaznar [U] (145)
- Content: Sortie: Bosses: Major
- Drops: Ra'Kaznar Frag. #2, Ra'Kaz. Starstone, Old Case, Old Case +1
- Image: mobimages/gartell.png
- Notes:
    - Sortie NM. Found past Diaphanous Gadget #F; needs a Ra'Kaznar Shard #F to access, and a Ra'Kaznar Metal F to limit its abilities. Level 145, 1,600,000 HP; uses Counter in excess of 500+ HP per hit. EVA 1,613. Title: Gartell Grinder. Traits: INT 350, MND 394. Also awards 10,000 Gallimaufry.
    - Its usable TP moves and elemental Resistance Rank depend on which hand element is showing. Thunder hand -> Zap / Concussive Shock / Undulating Shockwave (Undulating Shockwave changes it to Wind hands after); resistance rank 70% Earth, 5% every other element. Wind hand -> Chokehold / Tearing Gust / Shrieking Gale (Shrieking Gale changes it to Thunder hands after); resistance rank 70% Ice, 5% every other element. With both hands up only Ice damage is effective. Geomancy 50%.
    - Zap copies one debuff from Gartell to all party members in range — avoid applying strong DoTs (it may transfer them; a magic-bursted Helix practically guarantees a 1-shot on anyone inflicted). Chokehold steals one buff from each party member in range and transfers it to Gartell; absorbing Shell V makes nuking much harder, so cancel and re-apply Shell/Protect (Gartell seems to prioritize Shell and Protect). Tearing Gust inflicts a heavy Magic Defense Down — remove it (Erase/Panacea) or Gartell's attacks do increased damage. Shrieking Gale is heavy Wind damage plus knockback.
    - Dealing elemental damage (including skillchains) matching the current element heals it for extreme amounts and forces a rage — use the opposing element to proc blue (magic-burst for best odds). This also applies to Level 3 skillchains: do not use a Light skillchain, or you will force the Wind AND Thunder alignment procs.
    - After 3:00 it begins summoning a Gyve on the top-enmity player; these deal Wind or Thunder damage (the Gyve's colour indicates which) and inflict a very strong Shock and Choke effect of about -296 each — move the tank out of them and Erase/Panacea, since Gartell does much more damage with your VIT and MND reduced this much. Gains a stacking ~5% DT and ~5% damage-up per nameless attack, which also applies to its Gyve (dangerous if Gartell is left un-proc'd, especially with Choke's VIT down).
    - Any elemental damage opposing its currently selected element has a chance to proc blue (magic bursting strongly advised); a proc removes the DT/damage-up stacks and can disable the oldest elemental aura. Per SE, proccing multiple times can force a change of hands and will delay its use of 'special abilities'.

#### Leshonn
- Level: 135
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Job: Monk / Black Mage
- Resists: Fire -95%, Light -95%, Ice -95%, Earth -95%, Water -95%, Dark -95%
- Absorbs: Wind, Lightning
- Abilities: Chokehold, Concussive Shock, Shrieking Gale, Tearing Gust, Undulating Shockwave, Zap
- Zones: Outer Ra'Kaznar [U] (135)
- Content: Sortie: Bosses: Major
- Drops: Ra'Kaznar Shard #F, Ra'Kaz. Sapphire, Old Case, Old Case +1
- Image: mobimages/leshonn.png
- Notes:
    - Sortie NM. Found past Diaphanous Gadget #B; needs a Ra'Kaznar Shard #B to access. Level 135, ~870,000 HP; uses Counter in excess of 500+ HP per hit. Also awards 2,000 Gallimaufry.
    - Abilities and elemental resistances depend on which hand element is showing. Thunder hand -> Zap / Concussive Shock / Undulating Shockwave (Ra'Kaznar Metal B prevents the Stun rider on auto-attacks); Undulating Shockwave changes it to Wind hands after. Wind hand -> Chokehold / Tearing Gust / Shrieking Gale (Metal B prevents the Gravity rider); Shrieking Gale changes it to Thunder hands after.
    - Absorbs Wind and Lightning (its two hand elements). Its Wind hand opens an Ice weakness (~70%) and its Thunder hand opens an Earth weakness (~70%); everything else stays near-immune (~5%). Dealing elemental damage (including skillchains) matching the currently displayed element heals it for extreme amounts.
    - Zap copies a debuff from Leshonn to all party members on each use — extremely dangerous with Paralyze or Helix. Chokehold steals a buff from each party member and transfers it to Leshonn; a wipe is nearly guaranteed if it lands (block with Asylum).
    - Gains a stacking DT effect (~5%) and a stacking damage-up (~5%) each time it uses a nameless attack (it looks like it is sucking in the air around it). Any elemental damage opposing its current element has a chance to proc blue (higher damage almost always procs); a proc removes the DT/damage-up stacks and can disable the oldest elemental aura it has in effect. It appears to gain resistance to repeated procs from the same source — alternating SC > MB helps. Its hands can be locked out by defeating all enemies of a certain type in the area.

### Family: Soulflayer

> Any Soulflayer can use Reprobation (an AoE full Dispel) once brought to low HP.

## Ecosystem: Dragon

7 families, 207 monsters — Dragon, Hydra, Puk, Wyrm, Wyvern, Wyvern (Dragoon Pet), Zilant

### Family: Dragon

*Ecosystem Dragon · 59 recorded*

> Type: Dragon. Typical Job: Warrior. Detects by Sound. Despoil yields Dragon Blood (Evasion Down).
> Non-NM Dragons use only a subset of the family kit: Body Slam OR Heavy Stomp, only one type of breath, and only one of the three songs (Lodesong / Voidsong / Thornsong).
> Songs (Lodesong, Voidsong, Thornsong, Nullsong) are not used while the dragon is silenced.
> Dahak (red) variant: silencing it grants a 150 TP/tick regain but blocks its Song abilities. Every instance of water damage (including Enwater or Unda runes) reduces its TP by 300; every instance of fire damage increases its TP by 500.
> Purple variant: uses Discordant Note (knockback + Slow, Silence and a very potent Gravity).

#### Kulili
- Level: 1
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Warrior
- Abilities: Body Slam, Chaos Blade, Flame Breath, Heavy Stomp, Lodesong, Petro Eyes, Poison Breath, Thornsong, Voidsong, Wind Breath
- Zones: Xarcabard
- Notes:
    - Fields of Valor notorious monster. Spawns at the Field Parchment at (H-9) after obtaining a Chapter 4 Elite Training key item from the Field Manual, then trading up to 900 gil, up to 18 Beastmen’s Seals, or a level-45 item or under.
    - Roughly 2,000-2,500 HP and no MP. Drops no gil and cannot be mugged.
    - Appears to pick about three TP moves per fight and stick to them, described as five "attack modes": Wind Breath; Thornsong, Voidsong and Chaos Blade; Heavy Stomp and Body Slam; Petro Eyes; Lodesong. Flame Breath has also been seen. What causes a mode, or whether it can be changed, is unknown.
    - Carries an en-effect that seems to change — Endrain, Enpoison, Enstone, Enaero, Enwater, Enthunder, Enblizzard and Enaspir have all been seen.
    - Ice damage heals it: Blizzard IV healed it for 1,024 HP, and it may have a random element that heals it. Bind works.
    - May be able to intimidate players, sometimes has an auto-regen, has a very high level of accuracy, and its Petro Eyes can last an incredibly long time.

### Family: Hydra

*Ecosystem Dragon · 17 recorded*

> Type: Dragons. Typical Job: Warrior. Detects by Sound. Immune to Breath damage; highly resistant to all magic and to weapon damage.
> Three-headed. Heads break off to critical hits, Weapon Skills or damaging Job Abilities and regenerate over time. Which head is alive gates its TP moves.
> Pyric Bulwark grants an undispelable Magical Shield (right head); Polar Bulwark grants an undispelable Physical Shield (left head). Bring mixed physical/magical damage. In Nyzul Isle the head requirements are reversed.
> Gains Nerve Gas (AoE damage + a -50% HP/MP Curse + Poison) at low HP while all three heads are alive.

### Family: Puk

*Ecosystem Dragon · 24 recorded*

> Gains 1,000 TP when hit with magic matching the day’s element (includes Enspells, Reprisal, Sleep, etc.); never gains a Regain or Store TP effect.
> Reduced attack delay of 200 (vs. the standard 240).
> Job combo is BRD/BRD despite not using songs (typical job Bard).
> Family kit: Crosswind, Obfuscate, Wind Shear, Zephyr Mantle. Ill Wind is used only by Mamook Puks and NMs; White Wind only by Peapuks (once) and NMs (at will).
> Despoil steals Puk Wing (also inflicts Accuracy Down), Puk Egg (Slow), or Chimera Blood (Evasion Down).
> Wind wyverns — a chimera of dragon and vermin; capable of speech and sometimes serve the Mamool Ja Savages. Wind-based attackers.

### Family: Wyrm

*Ecosystem Dragon · 27 recorded*

> Four elemental resist profiles keyed to the Wyrm’s element: Standard & Fire (resists Fire/Lightning, weak Light), Ice (resists Ice/Lightning, weak Fire), Earth (resists Wind/Water, weak Ice), Dark (resists Dark, weak Earth/Light). All strongly resist Magical (~-40 to -50%).
> Magic damage taken varies by instance: KSNM99 ±0%, HNMs -50% (and -50% Ranged), ENM Ouryu Cometh -50%, ENM Wyrmking Descends -40%. Resistances may change mid-battle.
> Kit splits by posture: ground breaths (Fiery/Geotic/Glacial/Sable/Dragon Breath), sky blasts (Flame/Inferno/Orche/Sleet Blast), and elemental wings (Bai/Hurricane/Tebbad/Gregale/Cyclone Wing).
> Plus Absolute Terror (Terror), Horrid Roar (dispel + enmity reset), and Spike Flail (tail move, rear arc). Which breath/blast/wing a given Wyrm uses depends on its element and whether it is grounded or flying.

### Family: Wyvern

*Ecosystem Dragon · 48 recorded*

> Three subspecies with distinct resistances: Brown (base — resists Fire, weak to Wind/Earth/Light/Dark), Blue (heavily resists most elements and all physical except Slashing; weak to Lightning and Slashing), and Green (resists Fire/Ice; weak to Wind/Earth/Light/Dark).
> The Ajattara (Green Wyvern) subspecies gains an attack-speed bonus after enough wind damage is dealt to it.
> Despoil steals Wyvern Scales (also inflicts Magic Defense Down).
> Standard kit: Dispelling Wind, Dread Shriek, Deadly Drive, Fang Rush, Wind Wall, Radiant Breath, Tail Crush, Thunder Breath, plus the typical enhanced Wyvern movement speed. Notorious Monsters use enhanced variants (Deadly Dive, Dreaded Shriek) and extra elemental breaths (Hurricane / Blizzard / Chaos).
> Detects by Sight only (not true sight or sound; does not track by scent).

### Family: Zilant

*Ecosystem Dragon · 5 recorded*

> Type: Dragons · Typical Job: Warrior · Dark Crystal · detects by Sight and Sound.
> Positional cone family: Dexter Wing hits from the right, Sinister Wing from the left, Dancing Tail from behind, and Soul Douse / Chaos Blast / Abyssic Buster from the front.
> Wing state changes the damage it takes: both wings up = -25% physical / -75% magical; both wings down = -75% physical / -25% magical. It also takes extra physical and magical damage while casting a spell or readying a weapon skill.
> Its wing moves stack the family's spread of down-effects — Attack, Magic Attack, Accuracy, Magic Accuracy, Defense and Magic Defense Down.
> When its wings are up its TP moves gain extra effects (e.g. Dark Star adds Defense/Magic Defense Down; Soul Douse's Doom becomes a faster 5-count).
> Chilling Roar inflicts AoE Terror; on Notorious Monsters it also summons adds and/or raises the monster's level.

#### Anguis
- Level: 90-92
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sight, Sound
- Job: Warrior / Black Mage
- Crystal: Dark
- Resists: Fire -30%, Wind -30%, Lightning -30%, Ice -50%, Earth -50%, Water -50%, Dark -95%
- Immune: Paralysis, Silence, Bind, Gravity, Sleep, Petrification
- Abilities: Chilling Roar, Dark Star, Chaos Blast, Soul Douse, Sinister Wing, Dexter Wing, Dancing Tail, Abyssic Buster
- Spells: Comet, Blindga, Sleepga II, Meteor, Drain
- Zones: Walk of Echoes (90-92)
- Notes:
    - Summons Varanus — immobile adds with an enfeebling aura (Amnesia, Silence, Poison ~50/tick) — on the target of Chilling Roar; they despawn after ~2 minutes. The auras reach 3 yalms, so you can attack a Varanus from outside them.
    - Emits a 9-yalm Bio aura (-10% Attack) at set HP thresholds; the Bio starts at 5 HP/tick and grows as Anguis loses HP.
    - Toggles its wings up/down and its aura on/off roughly every 10% HP; wing-up TP moves gain extra effects (Soul Douse Doom drops to a 5-count, Dark Star adds Defense/Magic Defense Down, Chilling Roar gains heavy enmity reduction).
    - Soul Douse resets enmity on anyone it hits.
    - Uses Chilling Roar twice in a row at 20-11% HP and three times at <=10% HP (each summons a Varanus).
    - Casts Comet (up to 5 times in a row), Blindga and Sleepga II; below 50% HP it can also cast Meteor and Drain. Extremely high Store TP.
    - Immune to Paralysis, Silence, Bind, Gravity, Sleep and Petrification.

## Ecosystem: Elemental

6 families, 167 monsters — Elemental, Heartwing, Monoceros, Pixie, Porxie, Umbril

### Family: Elemental

*Ecosystem Elemental · 77 recorded*

*Swipeable resist grid — 12 sets: Fire, Ice, Wind, Earth, Thunder, Water, Light, Dark, Baelfyr, Gefyrst, Ungeweder, Byrgen. Members whose grid matches a set show all of them; the rest show their own.*

> Affinity Resistance: an elemental's resistance to offensive elemental magic depends on its element, and it uses spells and abilities based on that element (hybrids use two elements). Cycle/swipe the resist grid to compare each element and hybrid profile.
> All five weapon-skill damage types are cut to ~25%; Physical/Magical/Breath still land for full. A pure elemental takes only ~5% from its own element and the element it is strong against, and ~150% from its weakness. Hybrids resist six elements (two at ~5%, four at ~85%) and are weak to two (~150%).
> Silence prevents an elemental's TP moves. Some elementals change their resistances during battle.
> The Abyssean and Ru'Aun versions of the hybrid elementals (e.g. Ascended, Apex) do not use TP moves.

> Drift harmlessly around Eastern Ulbuka, trailing after adventurers.

### Family: Monoceros

*Ecosystem Elemental · 12 recorded*

*Swipeable resist grid — 2 sets: Monocero, Alicorn. Members whose grid matches a set show all of them; the rest show their own.*

> Unicorn elementals: Warrior-type, Fire-aligned. They come in two forms with different resistances — swipe the resist grid between the Monocero (Ixion) and Alicorn profiles. Ixion-named and base members use the Monocero table; Alicorn-named members use the Alicorn table.
> Movement Speed +75% while passive, +250% while aggressive.
> Monocero form uses Wrath of Zeus and Lightning Spear (thunder); Alicorn form uses Grace of Hera and Scintillant Lance (light). All forms share Acheron Kick, Damsel Memento, and Rampant Stance.

### Family: Pixie

*Ecosystem Elemental · 38 recorded*

> Pixies operate on a hate system: at minimum hate they are non-aggressive and will Cure players at yellow or lower HP, and will Raise a defeated player (no EXP loss). There is a long delay between a Pixie's casts.
> Defeating Pixies slowly degrades their helpfulness until they eventually become aggressive (the hate regenerates over time), and slowly reduces their population on a server -- raised again by trading Bottled Pixie items to the Fay Spring (Witchfire Glen, a north-western area of Grauberg [S]).
> Three resist profiles: base Pixie; Veela and Danaid (stronger elemental resistance, ~60%); Unseelie (the dark court -- strongly resists Dark instead of Light). All three take full physical damage, resist Magical (~25%), and are nearly immune to Wind (~95%).
> Casters (White Mage / Black Mage); detect by Magic and Sight; Wind Crystal.
> NM-only TP moves: Norn Arrow (~1000 AoE damage + ~1 min Encumbrance) and Eldritch Wind (AoE damage + full Dispel + Addle + Plague).

### Family: Umbril

*Ecosystem Elemental · 26 recorded*

> Spawns at night within field zones (may remain up within dungeons). Initially appears within the ground, then climbs out after detecting a player.
> Takes double damage from magical breath attacks (e.g. 1,000 Needles) on top of its magic damage reduction.
> Despoil: Leafkin Frond (Magic Defense Down) or Umbril Ooze (Attack Down).
> Dark Crystal shadow elemental: near-immune to Dark (-95%), weak to Light (+50%) and Fire (+30%); resists most other elements and physical (Slashing/Piercing/Ranged -50%). Detects by Sight and Magic.
> Sgili is a Fire-resistant, Earth-weak subspecies (see its notes).

### Family: Craver

*Ecosystem Empty · 12 recorded*

*Swipeable resist grid — 8 sets: Fire Core, Ice Core, Wind Core, Earth Core, Thunder Core, Water Core, Light Core, Dark Core. Members whose grid matches a set show all of them; the rest show their own.*

> Empty-type. Each Craver has an elemental "Core" that fixes its resistances — swipe the resist grid to the Core you are facing.
> Material Fend grants a substantial Evasion Bonus and must be dispelled.
> Impalement (NM only) leaves the target near death (~5% HP) and fully resets its enmity; mitigated by Sentinel's Scherzo, Migawari: Ichi, Earthen Armor, or an Automaton's Schurzen attachment.
> View Sync (NM only) draws in all players within ~25 yalms; Carousel follows it as a combo and is never used stand-alone.

### Family: Gorger

*Ecosystem Empty · 19 recorded*

*Swipeable resist grid — 8 sets: Fire Core, Ice Core, Wind Core, Earth Core, Thunder Core, Water Core, Light Core, Dark Core. Members whose grid matches a set show all of them; the rest show their own.*

> Empty-type. Each Gorger has an elemental "Core" that fixes its resistances — swipe the resist grid to the Core you are facing. Each Core resists its own element and the one it beats on the wheel, and is weak to the element that beats it.
> Possess the Magic Defense Bonus trait and are aspirable. Gorgers in the original three Promyvions likely have +10 MDB; those in Promyvion-Vahzl have +12 MDB.
> Blessing Sync (NM only) copies status enhancements from nearby players, including normally non-dispellable buffs (e.g. Dematerialize, Aftermath). Copying many effects grants a strong Damage Taken reduction — up to full immunity; dispel the stolen buffs to remove it. Enfeebling effects on the Gorger also count toward the reduction.
> Fission (NM only) summons an Offspring.

### Family: Wanderer

*Ecosystem Empty · 6 recorded*

*Swipeable resist grid — 8 sets: Fire Core, Ice Core, Wind Core, Earth Core, Thunder Core, Water Core, Light Core, Dark Core. Members whose grid matches a set show all of them; the rest show their own.*

> Empty-type. Each Wanderer has an elemental "Core" that fixes its resistances — swipe the resist grid to the Core you are facing. NOTE the Wind Core differs from other Empty families: it is weak to Ice only (not Ice + Water).

### Family: Weeper

*Ecosystem Empty · 6 recorded*

*Swipeable resist grid — 8 sets: Fire Core, Ice Core, Wind Core, Earth Core, Thunder Core, Water Core, Light Core, Dark Core. Members whose grid matches a set show all of them; the rest show their own.*

> Empty-type. Each Weeper has an elemental "Core" that fixes its resistances — swipe the resist grid to the Core you are facing. Each Core resists its own element and the one it beats on the wheel, and is weak to the element that beats it.
> Innate -10% Defense penalty. Possess the Magic Defense Bonus trait and are aspirable. Weepers in the original three Promyvions likely have +10 MDB; those in Promyvion-Vahzl have +12 MDB; Apex Woeful Lamenters have +14 MDB.
> Each Weeper also has Memory of [its element] — a 10' AoE nuke matching its Core element (e.g. a Fire-Core Weeper uses Memory of Fire).

    - Exploitable Weakness: its damage multiplier climbs as it takes magic damage or uses TP moves (every TP move except Tortoise Song). Magic multipliers in particular can be pushed extremely high (up to 800% or more).

    - Harden Shell’s Defense Boost is dispellable, but the dispel needs very high magic accuracy to land reliably.
    - Testudo Tremor is only used below 50% HP and deals severe Earth damage plus Stun and Weight — Earth-resistant gear helps reduce it.
    - Also yields the Semi-pure alizarin yggzi key item.

#### Tolba
- Level: 135
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Paladin

- Notes:
    - Tortoise Song dispels up to 3 buffs (including food) from everyone within 20 yalms.
    - Casts Earth and Water elemental magic, up to the -ga V tier.
    - Head Butt knocks back a long way and applies a strong Defense Down.
    - Harden Shell grants a large damage reduction until it is dispelled.
    - Earth Breath has a ~3-second charge (sidestep if you are its target); Aqua Breath is near-instant but hits for about half as much.
    - At 75/50/25/10/5% HP it withdraws into its shell and regenerates ~20% of its max HP, repeatedly drawing in its target. High Ice damage while it is shelled can proc a stagger that cancels the regen. On exiting the shell it draws in everyone in front, then follows with Earth Breath or Aqua Breath.
    - Drops Tolba’s Shell, the pop item for Kurmajara.
    - Standard adamantoise model.

    - Unlike normal Bugards, its Bone Crunch and Tusk are almost instant.

### Family: Gabbrath

*Ecosystem Lizard · 3 recorded*

> Normal auto-attacks are one of three types: Bite (single-target physical + Defense Down -20%), Charge (frontal AoE physical + Stun, heavy knockback), or Spin (AoE physical, light knockback).
> Gradually builds resistance to Stun. Silence prevents its TP moves.

    - Blistering Roar grants an aura and spawns fetters; its current weakness must be targeted to remove them. A 2-step skillchain triggers the Red weakness and opens a Blue weakness window; a 3-step triggers Blue and despawns fetters (later Blue weaknesses need an extra step). During its aura it absorbs Fire, so a Fusion or Light skillchain heals it.
    - Uses Brazen Rush at 75% HP.
    - Vengeance 20: an extra Kalunga's Matamata spawns at 75% HP; Vengeance 25: at 40% HP. Recommended V20 accuracy ~1,241.
    - Title: Kalunga Collapser.

    - Also yields the Venomous Peiste Claw and Atma of the Noxious Fang key items.

#### Maju
- Level: 145
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sight
- Job: Warrior
- Crystal: Water
- Resists: Breath -50%, Fire -95%, Wind -70%, Lightning -70%, Light -70%, Ice -50%, Earth -80%, Water -85%, Dark -70%
- Abilities: Backdraft, Delta Thrust, Oppressive Glare, Torpefying Charge
- Zones: Reisenjima (145)
- Content: Geas Fete: Reisenjima: Tier 3
- Spawn: Forced (examine ??? with a Maju's claw; all members need a Tribulens or Radialens), Reisenjima
- Drops: Hetairoi Ring, Merlinic Jubbah, Odyss. Chestplate, Perimede Cape
- Notes:
    - Geas Fete NM. Grants the title Maju Mauler. Roughly 900,000 HP and 150 magic defence; melee accuracy caps at about 1700.
    - Levels up if a skillchain is repeated before a certain number of totally different skillchains are used. A rotation such as Gravitation -> Compression -> Distortion -> Induration, repeated, never levels it up.
    - Uses Oppressive Glare if it is not blinded and its eyes glow orange: it inflicts Terror and Zombie on players facing the gaze, gains a massive Regen (~1% per tick), and makes enmity unstable. Blind prevents or removes it (signalled by a red !! proc when Blind lands), but Maju resists Blind heavily even with Bolster/Geo-Languor/Geo-Focus/Elemental Seal — spamming Blind for an Immunobreak is usually required, and higher magic accuracy plus lower magic evasion raises the Immunobreak rate. Benediction also cures through it; Full Cure does not.
    - Backdraft is a powerful Fire move that knocks back and inflicts a strong Burn DoT plus Gravity on those in the AoE. It is centred on the tank with a narrow range — players and Loupans directly behind Maju at ~4.5’+ can avoid it (assuming the tank is not standing inside Maju). Barfira and magic-evasion buffs cut the damage significantly, and it does not remove shadows.
    - Delta Thrust may occasionally spike on a tank, or outright KO a mage or DD. Shadows, boosting the target’s defence, or reducing Maju’s attack all reduce its potential.
    - Barparalyzra plus Accession + Divine Caress Paralyna from a well-geared White Mage effectively prevents Paralysis from Torpefying Charge.
    - Also drops the Frayed Sack (Pel) / (Fer) / (Tau) coffers, which are not present in the item database.
    - Clear reward unlocks the Occasionally Ignore Damage vorseal.

### Family: Wivre

> Will not turn to face their target.

> Despoil: Wivre Horn (Attack Down) or Wivre Hide (Defense Down).

#### Ferrodon
- Level: 119
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sight, Sound, Scent
- Job: Warrior
- Crystal: Earth
- Weak to: Wind +30%, Light +15%, Ice +30%, Water +15%, Dark +15%
- Resists: Breath -12.5%, Slashing -12.5%, Fire -15%, Lightning -15%, Earth -40%
- Abilities: Batterhorn, Boiling Blood, Clobber, Demoralizing Roar, Granite Skin, Crippling Slam
- Zones: Escha ZiTah (119)
- Content: Geas Fete: Escha ZiTah: Tier 1
- Spawn: Forced (leader examines ??? and pops with a Ferrodon's scale; all members need a Tribulens), Escha ZiTah
- Drops: Despair Greaves, Subtlety Spec., Pursuer's Doublet, Vanya Slops
- Notes:
    - Geas Fete NM. Its attack power increases significantly each time it uses an attack-power move (such as Berserk or Boost).
    - Immune to Dispel, but susceptible to Finale and Blank Gaze.
    - High-tier Water damage (especially magic bursted) procs a red !! and appears to reset its stacked attack-power buff.
    - Like other Wivre, pulling hate from behind makes it use a very high damage AoE move.
    - One ability shields it from damage directly in front — attack its front shoulders to avoid either doing no damage or pulling hate from behind and killing everyone in range.
    - Uses Crippling Slam for AoE damage once below 25% HP — extremely potent if its attack-power buff was never reset.
    - Has a constant aura that debuffs players so they cannot block, parry, or guard its attacks.

## Ecosystem: Luminian

7 families, 59 monsters — Aern, Euvhi, Hpemde, Phuabo, Wynav, Xzomit, Yovra

### Family: Aern

*Ecosystem Luminian · 12 recorded*

> Detects by Sound.
> Despoil steals Aern Organ or Luminian Tissue (Defense Down).
> Typical jobs vary across the family (Bard, Beastmaster, Black Mage, Monk, Ranger, Red Mage, Thief).
> Uses a weapon-dependent TP move in addition to the core kit: Hand-to-Hand → Sideswipe, Axe → Biotic Boomerang, Polearm → Medusa Javelin, Sword → Glacier Splitter, Dagger → Disseverment.

#### Absolute Virtue
- Level: 92
- Flags: NM, Links
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Dragoon
- Crystal: Wind
- Weak to: Fire +15%, Wind +15%, Lightning +15%, Ice +15%, Earth +15%, Water +15%, Dark +30%
- Resists: Light -70%
- Immune: Status Ailments
- Abilities: Medusa Javelin, Auroral Wind, Wing Thrust, Impact Stream, Explosive Impulse, Mighty Strikes, Hundred Fists, Manafont, Soul Voice, Chainspell, Meikyo Shisui, Call Wyvern, Familiar, Mijin Gakure, Astral Flow, Invincible, Benediction, Eagle Eye Shot, Draw In
- Spells: Tornado II, Aero V, Aeroga IV, Meteor, Comet, Maiden's Virelai
- Zones: AlTaieu (95)
- Spawn: Special (defeat Jailer of Love)
- Drops: Ninurta's Sash, Aureole, Futsuno Mitama, Bellona's Ring, Mars's Ring, Minerva's Ring, Raphael's Rod
- Notes:
    - Spawns with alliance-wide hate shortly after Jailer of Love is defeated; despawns if not beaten within two hours of Jailer of Love’s spawn. Estimated ~66,000 HP.
    - Can Draw In alliance members if the current hate target is too far away, and has +50% movement speed.
    - Very high Auto Regen. It can be reduced (and will not rise again, even after a wipe) by defeating all of Jailer of Love’s spawned pets before killing him, or by casting elemental spells of the corresponding day (~60 casts to minimize).
    - Damage resistance increases as its HP drops.
    - Casts Tornado II, Aero V and Aeroga IV with heavy casting-time reduction; adds Meteor and Comet below 80% HP or with Manafont (instant when Manafont + Chainspell are paired); with Soul Voice active it only casts Maiden’s Virelai to charm.
    - Below 60% HP it enters “bracelet mode” (bracelets appear), sharply raising all stats and letting it chain SP abilities in synergistic combinations.
    - Uses nearly every job’s original SP ability (except PUP/COR/BLU/DNC/SCH/RUN/GEO) every 45-90 seconds. Mighty Strikes/Hundred Fists stop its TP moves; Meikyo Shisui → Explosive Impulse or Medusa Javelin x5; Call Wyvern summons three Aern’s Wynavs (six in bracelet mode).
    - SP-lock: if a player with hate uses the same SP ability within ~2 seconds of Absolute Virtue, that ability is stripped from it for the rest of the fight (Call Wyvern is locked by a Dragoon’s own Call Wyvern, not Spirit Surge).
    - Main weapon is a Polearm. Bestows the title Virtuous Saint on defeat.

- Level: 150

- Abilities: Impact Stream, Auroral Wind, Medusa Javelin, Invincible, Benediction, Call Wyvern, Blood Weapon, Chainspell, Eagle Eye Shot, Hundred Fists, Manafont, Mijin Gakure, Mighty Strikes, Meikyo Shisui, Perfect Dodge, Soul Voice
- Zones: Escha RuAun (150)
- Content: Geas Fete: Escha RuAun: Nazar
- Spawn: Forced (examine ??? with Primal nazar)
- Drops: Alber Strap, Dacnomania, Habile Mazrak, Molybdosis, Telos Earring, Zendik Robe, Eschalixir +1
- Notes:
    - Forced spawn: examine the ??? in Escha - Ru’Aun with a Primal nazar (all members need Tribulens or Radialens). Assisted by six of Warder’s Wynav.
    - Gains a PDT/MDT bonus as its HP drops, capping at -50% damage taken. Trait: Dragon Killer.
    - Uses SP abilities from every pre-Treasures-of-Aht-Urhgan job, with no reuse limit and no fixed pattern except during Bracelets Mode.
    - Enters Bracelets Mode around 50-59% HP, where its stats rise and it chains SP abilities: Invincible→Benediction→Mijin Gakure; Chainspell→Manafont; Blood Weapon→Mighty Strikes→Hundred Fists; Call Wyvern→Soul Voice→Mijin Gakure (Wynavs mirror it); Call Wyvern→Familiar→Astral Flow; Meikyo Shisui→repeated Eagle Eye Shot.
    - An SP ability can be locked out by hitting it with elemental damage 1-2 seconds after it fires (Enspells, especially Accession+Enaero, work well). Wind blocks Call Wyvern/Invincible/Benediction/Manafont/Hundred Fists; Water blocks Meikyo Shisui/Mijin Gakure; Fire blocks Chainspell; Ice blocks Perfect Dodge/Mighty Strikes/Blood Weapon/Soul Voice.
    - Call Wyvern’s Wynavs target whoever is highest on the alliance enmity list (so anyone may pop it) and cast day-based -ga spells. Benediction fully heals it and cures all ailments — the only real counter is locking Invincible so it never gets the chance.
    - Soul Voice makes it charm with Maiden’s Virelai; negate it with a Charm Buffer or a Red Mage’s Stymie → Elemental Seal → Silence timed to the cast. Fealty, Tenebrae x3 + Pflug, and RUN abilities all fail to stop it.
    - When idle it instantly sheds all DoTs, so “zombie” recovery is impractical.

### Family: Euvhi

*Ecosystem Luminian · 11 recorded*

> Detects by Sound. Despoil steals Euvhi Organ or Luminian Tissue.
> Shifts between an open flower (Bloomed) form and a closed bud (Petal) form roughly every 80 seconds in combat; aggressive while open, passive while closed.
> In Petal (bud) form gains +100% Defense Bonus with standard weapon damage and delay; in Bloomed (flower) form has no Defense Bonus but +50% weapon damage and faster (3s) delay.
> Higher-than-standard Magic Defense Bonus (120). Uses different TP moves depending on its current form (see ability notes).
> Drops elemental crystal clusters rather than a single element, and grants a 10% EXP bonus on defeat.

*Swipeable resist grid — 8 sets: Fire Core, Ice Core, Wind Core, Earth Core, Thunder Core, Water Core, Light Core, Dark Core. Members whose grid matches a set show all of them; the rest show their own.*

> Changes forms over time, roughly every 60-75 seconds. Different forms take on aspects of different jobs and change the moves available. All forms cast magic.
> Ball Form (Black Mage): passive; uses Hexidiscs.
> Spider Form (Warrior): aggressive; uses Sickle Slash.
> Bird Form (Thief): aggressive; uses Damnation Dive.
> Humanoid Form (Paladin): aggressive; uses Vorpal Blade.
> Jobs may not actually change when shifting forms (unconfirmed).
> Elemental resistances follow the Ghrah's current Core element — cycle/swipe the resist grid to see each Core.

### Family: Zdei

*Ecosystem Luminion · 9 recorded*

> Possesses a Magic Defense Bonus of +20 (120 total). Aspirable.
> Swaps between a No-Ring/Bar mode and Ring/Bar (Ring / Pole) modes. First swap to a Ring/Bar mode is ~10-20 seconds after engaging; stays in No-mode 10-20s and in Ring/Bar modes 50-60s. Will not swap while charging Optic Induration.

### Family: Belladonna

*Ecosystem Plantoid · 4 recorded*

> Belladonna plantoids charm players and can sacrifice a nearby Rafflesia pet via Full Bloom to restore ~10% HP, erase debuffs, and gain a potent Stoneskin.
> Their charm moves (Frond Fatale, Beautiful Death) can be avoided with Charm Buffer, Fealty, or significant magic evasion / Light resistance.

    - May use Full Bloom on a charmed party member in range - an instant K.O. that heals the NM ~10% and levels it up. Stop feeding TP after a charm to prevent Full Bloom; a charmed player K.O.'d for any reason can't be Full Bloomed.

    - Normal melee attacks have a chance to absorb your buffs; keep Magic Finale and Dispel going. It gets much worse during Hundred Fists with a non-blink tank.
    - Does NOT have access to Counter.
    - Susceptible to Blind/Kurayami, Slow/Hojo and Paralyze/Jubaku.

### Family: Mandragora

*Ecosystem Plantoid · 66 recorded*

> Dream Flower (their Sleep AoE) is not used by Lycopodium-type Mandragoras.
> Despoil yields a Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud (Defense Down) or Saruta Cotton (Attack Down).

#### Albumen
- Level: 150
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Monk / Black Mage
- Crystal: Earth
- Resists: Magical -50%, Ranged -50%, Fire -30%, Wind -40%, Lightning -60%, Light -60%, Ice -60%, Earth -80%, Water -75%, Dark -40%
- Abilities: Scream, Petal Pirouette, Fatal Scream, Tepal Twist, Bloom Fouette, Petalback Spin, Phaeosynthesis, Hundred Fists, Leaf Dagger, Wild Oats
- Spells: Bindga, Silencega, Graviga, Paralyga, Blizzaga IV, Blizzard VI, Aeroga IV, Aero VI
- Zones: Reisenjima (150)
- Content: Geas Fete: Reisenjima: HELM
- Spawn: Forced: examine the ??? with an Albumen's flower (Reisenjima); all members need Tribulens or Radialens.
- Drops: Skaoi Boots, Ynglinga Sallet, Freydis, Steinthor
- Image: mobimages/pink_mandragora.png
- Notes:
    - Spawns with four adds and calls another set of four roughly every 2 minutes, to a maximum of 12 (three waves): Albumen Korrigan (RDM, enparalysis / Aero V / Silencega / Graviga), Albumen Lycopodium (WHM, Benediction, enslow), Albumen Mandragora (NIN, Mijin Gakure) and Albumen Pachypodium (DNC).
    - Albumen and every add fire their SP ability almost immediately on spawning, and can reuse them after an unknown delay. Adds are susceptible to Petrify and Sleep, but their resistances are high enough that Elemental Seal is recommended.
    - Tepal Twist (-50% Max HP) and Bloom Fouette (-50% Max MP) both increase to -75% potency below 25% HP. Watch for Hundred Fists during Tepal Twist.
    - Petalback Spin resets hate on the primary target only — wait a moment before reclaiming, or the reset won't have completed. If every ailment is resisted the hate reset does not take effect (Geo-Vex, Geo-Attunement, barspells, carols, Divine Caress and Fealty all help; Geomancers must re-dia after a hate reset).
    - Phaeosynthesis is night-only and must be dispelled within about a minute or it levels up.
    - Traits: Counter (high — can hurt melees badly), Enpetrify, high Regain.
    - It yields to Stun and does not build resistance, but its magic evasion is formidable — stunning by animation is the only reliable method since its special moves ready fast.
    - Melee accuracy caps at ~1821. Title: Albumen Aggrivator. Unlocks the Luck+ Vorseal.

- Detects: Sound
- Job: Monk
- Crystal: Earth
- Weak to: Piercing +25%, Ranged +25%, Fire +50%, Wind +50%, Lightning +50%, Ice +50%, Dark +50%
- Abilities: Dream Flower, Head Butt, Leaf Dagger, Photosynthesis, Scream, Wild Oats
- Zones: Yorcia Weald; Yorcia Weald [U]

    - Dream Flower resets hate — resistable, but the hate reset still happens.
    - Photosynthesis grants Regen and unlocks Petalback Spin and Scream; it can be dispelled but gains resistance with each dispel (negligible with decent magic accuracy).

#### Carousing Celine
- Level: 128
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Warrior
- Crystal: Earth
- Weak to: Fire +30%, Light +30%

- Drops: Celine's Vine, Gazu Bracelets, Gazu Bracelets +1, Odnowa Earring, Odnowa Earring +1
- Image: mobimages/morbol.png
- Notes:
    - Unity Notorious Monster: 2,400 Unity Accolades. Rift locations in Fei'Yin Map 1: (F-9), (I-7), (J-8).
    - ~155,000 HP, no MP.
    - UNM version of Capricious Cassie. Resistances are based off Capricious Cassie's values and are assumed; Fire is certainly a weakness.
    - Carousing Celine has low HP.
    - Like all Morbols it has low melee delay.
    - Sweet Breath applies sleep and resets enmity for those it lands on.
    - Bad Breath is more potent than usual — notably the blind and poison (~-200/tic to any DDs).
    - After Bad Breath, Celine gains a random aura from one of its effects. Gaining the aura removes all debuffs from her; the aura can be removed by applying that same debuff to her.
    - Melee Accuracy caps at ~1150 or less.
    - Drops Celine's Coffer. Celine's Vine is the pop item for Maverick Maude.

- Drops: Merlinic Hood, Niobid Strap, Odyssean Greaves, Pellucid Stone, Fern Stone, Taupe Stone
- Image: mobimages/purbol.png
- Notes:
    - M.DEF 120. Traits: enDrain, Magic Retaliation, Reduced Melee Delay.
    - Has access to typical Morbol abilities: Bad Breath, Drain Whip, Vampiric Lash, Tainting Breath (Conal Charm), Thousand Spears (AoE damage, amnesia), and Extremely Bad Breath (below 50%).
    - Vampiric Lash inflicts significant damage (tends to one-shot Trusts) and heals Dazzling Dolores, which may cause it to level up. /NIN for Utsusemi is recommended to mitigate this.
    - Absorbs Earth damage. Any skillchain that involves earth (Scission, Gravitation, or Darkness) will heal it.
    - Dolores levels up based on the amount of healing done, either from endrain, absorbing damage, or TP moves. Leveling up seems to grant it access to Extremely Bad Breath. Fire element damage and correlating skillchains may white-proc it, which levels it down and prevents the retaliation mechanic.
    - May retaliate against magic spells cast against it. The chance varies directly with the distance the player is from the NM — the further away, the higher the chance. Dolores will run over to the player, use Bad Breath, then run back to the previous target and use Vampiric Lash.
    - Tainting Breath and Bad Breath may be resisted via magic evasion boosts, such as Indi-Vex/Geo-Attunement, equipment, Miso Ramen, etc.
    - Susceptible to Stun.
    - Drops 1 of Merlinic Hood / Niobid Strap / Odyssean Greaves, 1-2 of Pellucid / Fern / Taupe Stone, and 1-3 Frayed Sacks.
    - Also unlocks the Magic Accuracy/Magic Evasion Vorseal.

- Image: mobimages/morbol.png
- Notes:
    - Drops Samantha's Coffer. Samantha's Vine is the pop item for Physis.
    - The fight occurs in 3 stages. It respawns in each stage with the remaining HP it had when it despawned; between stages you always disengage, which stops trusts healing you — have high HP before pushing its health down too far.
    - Stage 1: initially spawns as Steamy Samantha. Occasionally uses Bad Breath for ~1000 damage. Immediately uses Sweet Breath before despawning at roughly 75% HP.
    - Stage 2: respawns as Sultry Samantha and immediately uses Bad Breath for ~1500 damage. Frequently uses Bad Breath; occasionally Sweet Breath, Impale and Vampiric Lash. Gains a random, occasional enspell enfeeble effect this stage, from endrain to any of the enfeebles Bad Breath can inflict. Immediately uses Sweet Breath before despawning at 45-50% HP. Skipped entirely if enough damage is done during stage 1.
    - Stage 3: respawns as Sybaritic Samantha and immediately uses Bad Breath for ~1500 damage. Can use Bad Breath multiple times back to back without needing TP after the initial one (seems to come in waves of 3). Occasionally uses Sweet Breath, Impale and Vampiric Lash — these have no activation time and inflict 1000-1600 damage.
    - Stage 3 only: procs and becomes terrorized when players use weaponskills in response to a readied TP move. The proc is not guaranteed and seems to only work on Sweet Breath or Bad Breath.
    - Possesses a powerful regen of ~2% HP/tick. When proced, the regen is disabled for the duration of the terror (roughly 20 seconds).
    - All breath attacks are conal, not AoE, in every phase — a Paladin or Rune Fencer tank mitigates Bad Breath effectively. During stage shifts Bad Breath targets whoever had hate before the despawn, so all party members aside from the tank should run away during despawn/phase shifts.
    - It is impossible to one-shot this NM from stage 1 — it will always have at least 1 HP until it gets Bad Breath off for its final stage before it dies.

### Family: Rafflesia

*Ecosystem Plantoid · 21 recorded*

> Floral Bouquet charms nearby Bees; Bloody Caress then prioritizes draining the charmed Bees' HP over the player.
> Despoil yields Rafflesia Vine (Attack Down) or Rafflesia Petal (Defense Down).
> Blighted Bouquet is used only by Mitrastema-type Rafflesia.

- Notes:
    - Has a very potent endrain which increases over time. Endrain begins at 0 when first aggroed; merely holding the NM aggroed will increase it immensely — holding for 2 minutes increased his endrain to almost 400/hit in Delve. Recommended not to aggro or engage until you are completely ready to kill.
    - Spamming Fire damage on this NM will reduce its endrain effect.
    - If you wipe and try to fight again, he starts with the same endrain potency as when you wiped.
    - This fight may be challenging for White Mages, as they will need to cure fast. Recommended to have a support mage or /mage for erasing the HP down effect potentially applied by Infaunal Flop.
    - Drops 6-7 Airlixir / Airlixir +1 and the Impure russet yggzi key item.

### Family: Gyve

*Ecosystem Structures · 6 recorded*

> Immobile structures. Resistance to elemental offensive magic depends on the element of the Gyve/Fetter.
> Has a 20' enfeebling aura; the enfeebling effect is based on the element of the Gyve/Fetter.
> Trait — Affinity Resistance: resistance to elemental offensive magic depends on the elemental's element. Includes movement speed and gimmicks (e.g. Silence prevents TP moves).

#### Crystal Fetter
- Level: 99
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sight
- Weak to: Fire, Wind, Lightning, Light, Ice, Earth, Water, Dark
- Resists: Physical, Slashing, Impact, H2H, Piercing, Ranged
- Zones: Provenance
- Notes:
    - Approximately 5000 HP. Immobile; Provenance Watcher summons one after casting a spell, and the Fetter's element matches that spell (shown by its colour).
    - Carries a two-debuff aura keyed to its element: Fire = Burn + Attack Down; Ice = Frost + Magic Attack Down; Wind = Choke + Evasion Down; Earth = Rasp + Defense Down; Thunder = Shock + Accuracy Down; Water = Drown + Magic Defense Down; Light = Dia + prevents HP recovery; Dark = Bio + 5-count Doom.
    - While Fetters stand, damage to Provenance Watcher is cut sharply — about 99% with three present, 80% with two, 50% with one.
    - Each Fetter takes only one damage type by element: Ice/Earth/Water/Dark Fetters take physical only; Light/Fire/Wind/Thunder Fetters take magical only. Twilight Scythe (melee), Requiescat, and Quick Draw damage either type.

- Level: 109-135
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sound
- Weak to: Fire +15%, Light +15%

- Immune: Stun

- Abilities: Dire Whorl
- Spells: Comet, Holy II, Dispelga, Fire V, Blizzard V, Aero V, Stone V, Thunder V, Water V, Blizzaga III, Thundaga III, Waterga III, Flare, Freeze, Tornado, Quake, Burst, Flood, Poisonga II, Bio III, Burn, Frost, Choke, Rasp, Shock, Drown, Drain, Aspir II, Blaze Spikes, Stun, Blind, Bind, Sleep II, Sleepga II
- Zones: King Ranperres Tomb (109); FeiYin (125); Ranguemont Pass (135)
- Spawn: Quest (Epiphany; Hazy Rune behind Strange Apparatus)
- Notes:
    - ~17,000 HP. Spawned during Epiphany at the Hazy Rune behind the Strange Apparatus.
    - Casts single-target tier IV-VI elemental magic, Comet, and Holy II by day of the week: starts on the day's element and escalates in tier (IV→VI) the longer it stays before moving to the next element. Absorbs magic damage of its current element.
    - Most defensive buffs (Blink, Utsusemi, Shell, Phalanx, Protect, etc.) make it respond with Dispelga (removes two buffs) and enrage it — significantly higher power and higher-tier nukes; Rune Fencer buffs (Valiance, Vallation, One for All) do NOT trigger this.
    - Melee and Dire Whorl damage are low relative to its magic damage. Trait: Fast Cast.

### Family: Humanoid

*Ecosystem Unclassified · 76 recorded*

#### Aita
- Level: 145
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Job: Rune Fencer / Dark Knight
- Resists: Fire -95%, Wind -95%, Lightning -95%, Light -95%, Ice -95%, Earth -95%, Water -95%, Dark -95%
- Abilities: Eroding Flesh, Flaming Kick, Flashflood, Fulminous Smash, Icy Grasp, Vivisection
- Zones: Outer Ra'Kaznar [U] (145)
- Content: Sortie: Bosses: Major
- Spawn: Sortie: found past Diaphanous Gadget #H in Outer Ra'Kaznar [U]. A Ra'Kaznar Shard #H is needed to access it.
- Drops: Ra'Kaznar Frag. #4, Ra'Kaz. Starstone, Old Case, Old Case +1
- Image: mobimages/aita.png
- Notes:
    - Sortie NM. Found past Diaphanous Gadget #H; needs a Ra'Kaznar Shard #H to access. EVA 1,613. Title: Aita Abnegater. Traits: Cumulative WS Resistance, INT 494, MND 427. Also awards 10,000 Gallimaufry.
    - Changes its elemental weakness based on the TP move it uses; counter with the opposing element's magic damage to proc blue (!!): Flaming Kick (Fire) -> counter with Water; Flashflood (Water) -> counter with Thunder; Icy Grasp (Ice) -> counter with Fire; Eroding Flesh (Earth) -> counter with Wind; Fulminous Smash (Lightning) -> counter with Earth. Even 0-damage subjob Elemental Magic will proc it. Using an elemental TP move after the first summons fetter(s) that deal damage and an element-based DoT; the number of fetters grows as HP drops.
    - Resistance ranking: 150% (very weak) to the last TP move's element, 70% (weak) to its current elemental weakness, and 5% (near-immune) to every other element. Geomancy 50%. It gains -5% Damage Taken for each 30 seconds it remains un-proc'd after a TP move (e.g. Flaming Kick -> -DT vs Water until proc'd), retained for the rest of the fight; proccing does NOT reset accumulated DT.
    - Vivisection is used every 3 minutes and generally kills everyone within its 20+ yalm range. Elemental Sforzo / Liement / Perfect Defense / Mana Wall / Annuls Damage procs stop its damage; Valiance and other magic-damage-reduction effects reduce it. Correctly proccing blue reduces Vivisection's damage and, below a threshold, removes its wings (and slows the seal decay). Vivisection can also be triggered by healing Aita with the last TP move's Elemental Magic or a matching skillchain. Vivisection resets the elemental weakness — a new TP move must be used before it is vulnerable again.
    - On a full wipe, accumulated DT is NOT reset unless you leave the battle area, wait a while, then re-enter. During a wipe/recovery the timer does not stop; after three idle minutes the first move Aita uses is Vivisection, and it must hit a target before the timer resets (you may not bind and run away while the timer passes).

#### Aminon
- Level: 149
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Job: Rune Fencer / Dark Knight
- Resists: Ranged -95%, Fire -95%, Wind -95%, Lightning -95%, Light -95%, Ice -95%, Earth -95%, Water -95%, Dark -95%
- Abilities: Bane of Tartarus, Blast of Reticence, Ceaseless Surge, Crippling Agony, Demonfire, Ensepulcher, Eternal Misery, Frozen Blood, Impudence, Incessant Void, Tenebrous Grip, Torrential Pain
- Zones: Outer Ra'Kaznar [U] (149)
- Content: Sortie: Bosses: Aminon
- Spawn: Sortie: the final battlefield. Requires all four Ra'Kaznar Fragments; entered via the Diaphanous Gadget in Sector E (up the ramp west of the 12 Flan room).
- Drops: Ra'Kaz. Starstone, Old Case +1
- Image: mobimages/aminon.png
- Notes:
    - Sortie NM — the final boss. Level 149, ~5,500,000 HP. Title: Aminon Apprehender. Also awards 30,000 Gallimaufry. Requires all four Ra'Kaznar Fragments to access; entered via the Diaphanous Gadget in Sector E (up the ramp west of the 12 Flan room).
    - If anyone in the party has a stage-4 Prime Weapon, a second option appears: Normal mode 'Forward!' (Mesosiderite will NOT drop) vs Hard mode 'To the deepest dark!' (Mesosiderite has a chance to drop only for stage-4 players). Aminon is locked into hard mode for the rest of the run, so choose carefully. It always opens the fight with Incessant Void a few moments after aggro/pull (usually about 2 melee rounds).
    - Changes its elemental weakness based on the TP move used; counter with the opposing element's magic damage to proc blue (!!): Demonfire (Fire) -> counter with Water; Torrential Pain (Water) -> counter with Thunder; Frozen Blood (Ice) -> counter with Fire; Ensepulcher (Earth) -> counter with Wind; Ceaseless Surge (Lightning) -> counter with Earth; Blast of Reticence (Wind) -> counter with Ice. Even 0-damage subjob Elemental Magic procs it; countering with the correct element five times in a row procs a stronger !! and removes active fetters. Unaffected by Slow/Elegy.
    - Resistance ranking: 5% (near-immune) to any element that is not its last TP move's element, 150% (very weak) to the corresponding element (Fire after Demonfire, etc.), and 70% to its current elemental weakness. Geomancy 50%; it also resists Ranged attacks at 5%. It gains -5% Damage Taken for each 30 seconds it stays un-proc'd after a TP move, retained for the rest of the fight; proccing does NOT reset accumulated DT, and the DT is not reset even after leaving the battle area and returning.
    - Bane of Tartarus is used every 4 minutes from the start of battle: it Dispels all buffs including food, inflicts Death and a ~60-second weakness, and generally KOs everyone within its ~20+ yalm range. The Death effect can be resisted with Resist Death gear; a proc delays the timer. Unlike Setting the Stage it can be stopped by Elemental Sforzo (though it still fully dispels and weakens); Perfect Defense and Mana Wall also work; Valiance and other magic-damage-reduction reduce it; possessing a Ra'Kaznar Seal reduces its power (potentially survivable with Scherzo/Migawari/Earthen Armor, though testing is needed). It can also be triggered by healing Aminon with the matching Elemental Magic or skillchain to the last TP move. On a wipe/recovery the timer does not stop; after three idle minutes the first move is Bane of Tartarus, which must hit a target before the timer resets (you may not bind and run away while the timer passes).
    - Possessing a Ra'Kaznar Seal changes several abilities: Bane of Tartarus prevents its Death; Blast of Reticence inflicts Silence instead of Mute; Crippling Agony prevents equipment removal; Demonfire inflicts Burn (-19/tic) instead of Plague; Ensepulcher inflicts Slow instead of Petrification; Eternal Misery and Impudence inflict Haunt with no enmity reset; Incessant Void prevents its Dispel; Tenebrous Grip prevents Reraise removal; Torrential Pain inflicts Poison instead of Taint.

    - Spirits Within can destroy a tank — Gravity + Bind and kiting is the usual strategy.
    - Arrogance Incarnate is a modified Spirits Within that hits targets within ~5'.
    - At 30% and under she uses Chant du Cygne twice to make a Light skillchain.
    - Uses Invincible multiple times and Benediction once (triggered when the tank is cured for ~800+ HP).
    - Casts Aquaveil, Blink, Haste plus offensive divine magic (Diaga II, Banishga III, Holy II).
    - Entry via Phantom Gem of Arrogance at Home Point 4, Ru'Aun Gardens.
    - Titles: Ark Elvaan Eviscerator / Vanquisher of Arrogance.

- Level: 102

    - Approximately 27,000 HP. One spawn per battlefield.
    - Fought during the tenth limit-break quest, Beyond Infinity.
    - Normal melee attacks carry extra physical damage that looks like Enfire. Ochain converts that added damage to MP if you block the normal hit; Barfire does not reduce it, because the damage is physical.

    - Using an Olde Rarab Tail on it freezes it in place for 90 seconds and removes its damage resistance for the duration.
    - Gains resistance to Stun over repeated use.
    - Can use any Hand-to-Hand weapon skill, and chains them back to back for skillchains. Asuran Fists reaches about 3,900 damage.
    - Extremely accurate — its hit rate stays capped against a level 95 Thief in full evasion gear.
    - Holds party-wide hate and does not go passive until every member in the battlefield is KO'd.

#### Degei
- Level: 135
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Job: Rune Fencer / Dark Knight
- Resists: Fire -95%, Wind -95%, Lightning -95%, Light -95%, Ice -95%, Earth -95%, Water -95%, Dark -95%
- Abilities: Eroding Flesh, Flaming Kick, Flashflood, Fulminous Smash, Icy Grasp, Vivisection
- Zones: Outer Ra'Kaznar [U] (135)
- Content: Sortie: Bosses: Major
- Spawn: Sortie: found past Diaphanous Gadget #D in Outer Ra'Kaznar [U]. A Ra'Kaznar Shard #D is needed to access it.
- Drops: Ra'Kaznar Shard #H, Ra'Kaz. Sapphire, Old Case, Old Case +1
- Image: mobimages/degei.png
- Notes:
    - Sortie NM. Found past Diaphanous Gadget #D; requires a Ra'Kaznar Shard #D to access. EVA 1,249. Also awards 2,000 Gallimaufry.
    - Enrages after fighting for 3 minutes, after which it takes 1/4 damage and only uses Vivisection. Rage is not removed by regenning back to 100% HP.
    - Changes its elemental weakness based on the TP move used, and heals to the current element; casting magic of the opposing element procs blue (!!): Flaming Kick (Fire) -> counter with Water; Flashflood (Water) -> counter with Thunder; Icy Grasp (Ice) -> counter with Fire; Eroding Flesh (Earth) -> counter with Wind; Fulminous Smash (Lightning) -> counter with Earth. Any appropriate magic triggers the proc, even Threnody or subjob Elemental Magic.
    - Gains Damage Resistance (~-5% DT, retained) for each 30 seconds it stays un-proc'd after changing elements.
    - Vivisection is used roughly every 3 minutes, and can be triggered early by healing Degei with the wrong Elemental Magic or a wrong skillchain and failing to proc in time (higher heal amounts may need more procs). After Vivisection it keeps the Damage Taken accumulated from not proccing and has no weakness — feed it TP quickly so it uses one of the five elemental moves again. On a wipe/recover the first move is Vivisection. Wrong skillchains heal Degei, so it is best to avoid skillchains entirely in a melee zerg.

#### Eald'narche
- Level: 78
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sight, True Sight
- Job: Black Mage
- Resists: Fire -15%, Wind -15%, Lightning -15%, Light -15%, Ice -15%, Earth -15%, Water -15%, Dark -15%
- Abilities: Gaea Stream, Uranos Cascade, Cronos Sling, Phase Shift, Vortex, Stellar Burst, Omega Javelin
- Spells: Flare, Freeze, Tornado, Quake, Burst, Flood, Flare II, Freeze II, Tornado II, Quake II, Burst II, Flood II, Sleepga II, Bindga

- Content: Master Trials: Crystal Paradise
- Drops: Vanir Knife, Vanir Gun, Vanir Cotehardie, Vanir Battery, Vanir Boots
- Image: mobimages/eald'narche.png
- Notes:
    - The Celestial Nexus II — fought in The Celestial Nexus with a Celestial Nexus phantom gem (all members need the key item). Also fought at Empyreal Paradox during Apocalypse Nigh.
    - Has two forms. Susceptible to Stun, Violent Flourish, Paralyze, and Slow.
    - First form: assisted by Exoplates and two Orbitals — the Exoplates must be defeated before Eald'narche can be damaged. Orbitals have high evasion and can be slept (Lullaby/Light Shot/Sleep) but gain resistance over time.
    - First form: Phase Shift at 66%, 33%, and 1% HP does high damage — mages/DD without Utsusemi should stand beyond 30'. Casts tier-1 Ancient Magic, Sleepga II, and Bindga; has high evasion.
    - Once the Exoplates die he stops summoning Orbitals and using TP moves, and begins spamming tier-1 Ancient Magic.
    - Second form: fast attack speed, still high evasion; warps around the room to whoever has hate (and sometimes at random). Casts tier-2 Ancient Magic and gains -ja spells at 25% (very high damage if unresisted).
    - Vortex resets hate — running away after it may send him at someone else.
    - Title: Dream Distiller (VD only).

#### Lady Lilith
- Level: 81-82
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sight
- Job: Dancer / Black Mage
- Resists: Breath -25%, Light -30%, Dark -50%
- Abilities: Dark Thorn, Durance Whip, Moonlight Veil, Petaline Tempest, Subjugating Slash, Fatal Allure
- Spells: Breakga, Dispelga, Silencega, Graviga, Bindga, Slowga, Comet, Meteor
- Zones: Walk of Echoes (81-82)
- Image: mobimages/lady lilith.png
- Notes:
    - Maiden of the Dusk (Wings of the Goddess Mission 51, Walk of Echoes) — released at the level 90 cap. Lady Lilith is the first form: DNC/BLM, ~9,800 HP. Immune to Silence and Sleep, resistant to Stun. Auto-attacks are AoE dark damage that remove shadows and knock back.
    - Uses Dark Thorn (self Dread Spikes + Stoneskin), Durance Whip (cone + Bio/Bind/Amnesia), Moonlight Veil (AoE + Terror, spawns a Dark Gyve), Petaline Tempest (AoE + Max HP/MP/TP down), and Subjugating Slash (cone Knockback that dispels 3 buffs). Enters Trance at 50% (then freely), gaining the gaze-Charm Fatal Allure — avoid it by facing away from her. Also casts Breakga/Dispelga/Silencega/Graviga/Bindga/Slowga/Comet, and Meteor at low HP.
    - A ring of Gyves encircles the arena: they absorb all magic and attack anyone within 6′, and players outside the ring cannot damage Lilith. TP moves summon element-themed Gyves that persist. On defeat she is replaced by Lilith Ascendant.
    - High-Tier ★ (Maiden phantom gem, Walk of Echoes [P], title Lilith Liquidator): her grid shifts to Breath -50% / Fire-Wind-Lightning -50% / Light -80% / Ice-Earth-Water -60% and she ABSORBS Dark. After being struck by a Blood Pact she takes 90% less damage from Blood Pacts for 10s, so avoid them. ~200k HP on Very Easy.
