#### Lilith Ascendant
- Level: 83-84
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sight, True Sight
- Job: White Mage / Black Mage
- Resists: Breath -50%, Fire -40%, Wind -40%, Lightning -40%, Light -80%, Ice -40%, Earth -40%, Water -40%, Dark -80%
- Abilities: Dark Burst, Dark Flare, Dark Flood, Dark Freeze, Dark Quake, Dark Tornado, Dark Moon, Dark Sun
- Spells: Fire IV, Blizzard IV, Aero V, Stone V, Thunder IV, Water V, Firaga III, Blizzaga III, Thundaga III, Waterga III, Flare, Freeze, Tornado, Quake, Burst, Flood, Poisonga II, Bio III, Burn, Frost, Choke, Rasp, Shock, Drown, Drain, Aspir II, Blaze Spikes, Stun, Blind, Bind, Sleep II, Sleepga II
- Zones: Walk of Echoes (83-84)
- Drops: Daybreak, Malignance Pole, Malignance Sword, Malignance Earring
- Notes:
    - Maiden of the Dusk — Lilith Ascendant is the second form, spawning after Lady Lilith falls (Walk of Echoes, WotG Mission 51). WHM/BLM, ~17,000 HP. Immune to Silence and Sleep, resistant to Stun.
    - Its Dark-element conal/AoE moves each summon a matching element Gyve: Dark Burst (Lightning, Stun + resets its ability timers → Thunder Gyve), Dark Flare (Fire, TP reset + enmity down → Fire Gyve), Dark Flood (Water, Encumbrance + knockback → Water Gyve), Dark Freeze (Ice, Terror + enmity down → Ice Gyve), Dark Quake (Earth, Bind + Amnesia → Earth Gyve), Dark Tornado (Wind, full Dispel + knockback → Wind Gyve).
    - Below 50% it adds Dark Moon (AoE Dark + Weakness → two Dark Gyves) and Dark Sun (AoE Light + chance of Death → two Light Gyves). Each Light Gyve present cuts the damage it takes; once five are up it is immune to damage, so clear Gyves between its TP moves.
    - High-Tier ★: its grid shifts to Breath -50% / Fire-Wind-Lightning -80% / Ice-Earth-Water -50% / Dark -80% and it ABSORBS Light. ★ rewards: Daybreak, Malignance Pole/Sword/Earring (the Malignance Box container drops here too but is not tracked as gear).

#### Perfidien
- Level: 130
- Flags: NM
- Resists: Fire -50%, Wind -50%, Lightning -50%, Light -50%, Ice -50%, Earth -50%, Water -50%, Dark -50%
- Abilities: Eroding Flesh, Flaming Kick, Flashflood, Fulminous Smash, Icy Grasp, Vivisection
- Zones: RaKaznar Inner Court (130); Outer Ra'Kaznar [U] (130); RaKaznar Turris (130)
- Content: Vagary: Additional NMs: Legs
- Drops: Tartarian Chain, Tartarian Soul, Count's Cuffs, Count's Garb, Enervating Earring, Etiolation Earring
- Image: mobimages/perfidien.png
- Notes:
    - Perfidien Paindealer, a Vagary NM (~630,000 HP, Level 130) fought at the Duskbrood Gate ??? in Outer Ra'Kaznar and, via Alternative Vagary, in Ra'Kaznar Inner Court (which grants the Reforged Empyrean Armor +1 legs upgrade). To spawn: defeat elementals with tier IV/V spells matching their weakness (or the 8 hybrid Blue Magic elemental spells) five times, perform a 4-step skillchain, and defeat elementals with magic bursts five times. Warps away if a player is KO'd or if left un-proc'd too long; each defeat extends the time limit by 15 minutes.
    - From 90% HP it rotates its elemental (and eventually physical) weakness every 10-15%, shown by a cloud animation whose color is the element it currently resists — its weakness is the two elements ascendant from that color. The susceptible element shifts to 130% while the opposite affinity is absorbed. A !! proc and /emote fire when the weakness is first inflicted, and a !!! proc lands after ~23,000 damage of the weak element; the weakness then changes ~2 minutes later or after enough HP is depleted. Healing Perfidien inflicts Encumbrance (scaled to the heal) and, if overdone, triggers Vivisection and a level-up. Light/Dark skillchains feed the element it is currently absorbing.

#### Raubahn
- Level: 75-80
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: True Sight
- Job: Blue Mage
- Spells: Eyes On Me, Metallic Body, Screwdriver, MP Drainkiss, Sandspin, Terror Touch, Digest, Sickle Slash, Cocoon, Filamented Hold, Pollen, Radiant Breath, Jet Stream, Sound Blast, Feather Tickle, Yawn, Voracious Trunk, Claw Cyclone, 1000 Needles, Pinecone Bomb, Sprout Smack, Soporific, Wild Oats, Bad Breath, Awful Eye, Infrasonics, Sandspray, Hydro Shot
- Zones: Jade Sepulcher (70); Leujaoam Sanctum; Nyzul Isle
- Spawn: One spawn in each of three fights: The Beast Within in the Jade Sepulcher, Red Versus Blue in Leujaoam Sanctum, and Nashmeira’s Plea on Nyzul Isle.
- Notes:
    - A mission boss. In The Beast Within — the Blue Mage limit break — he uses pre-Wings of the Goddess Blue Magic up to level 70, every sword weapon skill available to a level 70 Blue Mage, Quick Magic, and often answers your own Azure Lore with his.
    - In Red Versus Blue he must be defeated to unlock the Rune of Release and clear the assault; roughly 3,000 HP there.
    - In Nashmeira’s Plea he fights alongside Razfahd but can be pulled separately, since Razfahd cannot move. 5,500-6,000 HP.
    - He Reraises twice. After each Reraise he gains a partial resistance — around 50% — to whichever damage type mostly killed his previous life, announced in the chat log. Those resistances stack, so if the first two kills use the same type he is immune to it on the third life. Killing him once with magic damage avoids making him immune to melee.
    - He uses Azure Lore once on his second life and once on his third, and is susceptible to sleep.
    - Eyes On Me is the only blue magic he casts in that fight: heavy damage, not blocked by Utsusemi shadows, but stunnable.

    - Seed of Deception clones the targeted player as a 'Seed Thrall' that attacks the current hate-holder (used often). Seed of Nihility resets every party member's job-ability recast timers to maximum, including two-hour abilities. Seed of Deference charms and puts victims in a Mandragora costume. Seed of Judgement is a high-damage knockback used only below 50% HP.

### Family: Replica

*Ecosystem Unclassified · 31 recorded*

> Dynamis 'Replica' constructs — effigies, idols, tombstones and golems modeled on the Beastmen, found in the Divergence versions of the four original Dynamis zones (and as Prototypes in Dynamis-Tavnazia).
> Every Replica uses Seismostomp, plus one signature move set by the Beastman it mimics: Quadav effigies use Lead Breath (Weight), Orc tombstones use Numbing Glare (Paralysis), Yagudo idols use Tormentful Glare (Curse), and Goblin golems use Torpid Glare (Sleep).

### Family: Supreme Being

#### Shinryu
- Level: 90-92
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
- Detects: Sight, True Sight
- Resists: Fire -40%, Wind -40%, Lightning -40%, Ice -40%, Earth -40%, Water -40%, Light -70%, Dark -70%
- Abilities: Draw In, Atomic Ray, Cataclysmic Vortex, Cosmic Breath, Dark Matter, Gyre Charge, Mighty Guard, Supernova, Protostar, HP Cloak, Battle Stances
- Spells: Meteor, Comet
- Zones: Abyssea-Empyreal Paradox
- Content: Abyssea: Abyssea-Empyreal Paradox: Zone Boss
- Drops: Twilight Cape, Twilight Knife, Twilight Scythe, Twilight Helm, Twilight Mail, Twilight Cloak, Twilight Torque, Twilight Belt, Crepuscular Knife, Crepuscular Scythe, Crepuscular Helm, Crepuscular Mail, Crepuscular Cloak, Crepuscular Pebble, Crepuscular Ring
- Image: mobimages/shinryu.png
- Notes:
    - The Wyrm God, an Abyssea Notorious Monster fought in Abyssea-Empyreal Paradox (~65,000 HP; ~800,000 on the Very Difficult ★ battlefield). Entry needs 10,000 cruor and a Crimson traverser stone. Title Wyrm God Defier.
    - Despite the name and the shape, it is NOT a member of the dragon family.
    - Stances: it opens with wings spread and swaps roughly every three minutes. Spread, it absorbs damage dealt while it readies a weaponskill or casts, and uses -ga spells; folded, it absorbs nothing, takes about 30% less damage from everything, and casts Ancient Magic instantly. The page notes it is likely but UNCONFIRMED that Comet goes with folded wings and Meteor with spread.
    - HP gates: at 66% it gains Atomic Ray, Dark Matter, tier-2 Ancient Magic and tier-5 -ga. At 33% it gains Protostar, Supernova, Comet and Meteor. It opens the fight with all tier-1 Ancient Magic and tier-4 -ga.
    - Nearing defeat it may repeat one of Protostar, Supernova, Comet or Meteor up to five times in a row. Meteor spam has a 30-yalm range and is very hard to survive without a Primeval Brew; Fool's Drink and Fool's Powder are the usual answer.
    - Its standard melee swings count as TP moves, the way an Iron Giant's do, so "!!" weaknesses can only be struck by timing your attacks into the gaps between its swings. Those swings are a conal AoE of roughly 10 yalms and are blocked by 1-4 Utsusemi shadows.
    - It also hits anyone standing at its tail when it attacks, and the tail attacks carry an Additional Effect: Stun — which makes retreating after a Draw In genuinely dangerous. Triggering a blue weakness stops it meleeing for the duration.
    - Red, blue and yellow stagger windows key off the time SHINRYU HAS BEEN ENGAGED, not the time you entered the battlefield.
    - Susceptible to red, blue and yellow "!!" staggers, and to Slow, Paralyze, Addle and Blind. Immune to Stun.
    - The Atma is granted on winning AND on exiting the BCNM if you managed to trigger a red weakness. Any Atma, cruor enhancement and Abyssea temporary item may be used against it.
    - Solo with a Primeval Brew is possible but has two traps. Supernova's Doom is not covered by the brew and will kill you fast — bring a Doom Screen. And using the brew while its wings are spread, into a TP move or a cast, feeds it a huge heal through Damage Absorption; wait for the wings to fold first.
    - 30-minute battlefield time limit. That is the standard BCNM clock and has nothing to do with Visitant status, which is unlimited in Abyssea - Empyreal Paradox.

### Family: Tubes

*Ecosystem Unclassified · 5 recorded*

> Crystal War smart bombs designed by Adelheid Sturm to cripple the forces of the Beastmen Confederate. These levitating bombs detonate after a set time once a target is close, and each releases an area-of-effect blast that inflicts a status ailment.
> A large number were stolen from Bastok by the Quadav during the raids on Grauberg. The Quadav shared them with the Goblins, who reverse-engineered them into very potent poison-inducing vials and flasks and sold those on to the Orcish Hosts.
> Immobile, and despawns after using an ability.
> Cannot be charmed and cannot be used in Pankration. Aspir and Drain both work.
> Each blast is locked to its own type: Silencing Blast to Silencing Tubes, Binding Blast to Binding Tubes, Paralyzing Blast to Paralyzing Tubes. Noxious Spray carries no such restriction. All four appear in Wings of the Goddess areas.

### Family: Corse

*Ecosystem Undead · 25 recorded*

> Ordinary Corse carry a standard 100 Magic Defense; Notorious Monsters tend to have a comparably higher value. Add their higher INT and a 25% cut to magic damage and Corse are a bit more resilient to magic than other foes.
> Typical Corse are DRK/DRK.
> Robe colour gates two moves: Final Retribution is "Staff wielding Corses only" and Hadal Summons is "Purple Robe Corses (Kumakatok) only".

    - Gains access to Danse Macabre at about 25% HP (single-target Charm) - have Fealty ready if you are tanking on PLD.
    - Chainspells at 10% HP, and casts Memento Mori before every spell during it if the buff is not already up.
    - Mimics nukes cast at it, the way Colibri do.
    - Drops 1-3 Frayed Sacks (Pel/Fer/Tau) and unlocks the Magic Attack Vorseal.
    - Popped with Belphegor's crown.

Ice: Paralysis and Frost (-10 HP/tic, AGI -23) for 30 seconds. Water: Poison (-30 HP/tic) and Drown (-10 HP/tic, STR -23) for 30 seconds.

    - Geas Fete NM. Unlocks the Accuracy/Evasion Vorseal. Also drops 1-3 Frayed Sacks (Pel/Fer/Tau).
    - Takes significantly reduced damage from the front and frequently negates damage outright by blocking with its shield - attack from the sides or behind.

    - Susceptible to Silence, Addle, and to multiple forms of Stun including Sudden Lunge, Tachi: Hobaku and Leg Sweep - but it gradually builds resistance to Stun.
    - Tends to use Noahionto after Absorb-TP, but can use it freely. Stun it: Lux Valiance and Holy Circle reduce the damage, and Migawari: Ichi negates it entirely.
    - Infernal Bulwark also grants it Ice Spikes here. Dispel is unreliable against it, but it is very susceptible to Magic Finale, Droning Whirlwind and Blank Gaze.

Gravity or Bind it during SP and wait the timer out; it loses the moves when the SP wears.

    - Gogmagog's Dullahan has Noahionto and can one-shot the party with it.
    - Dispel its Infernal Bulwark buffs if possible.

### Family: Fomor

*Ecosystem Undead · 199 recorded*

> Shadows are the Elvaan types in chainmail, typically found in The Eldieme Necropolis. They predate Fomors and keep their own resistances, but operate as a sub-species of Fomor.
> Shadows use only Dimensional Death, though some Shadow notorious monsters can also use Fomor TP moves.
> Foxfire is used only by Fomors wielding a one-handed weapon, Grim Halo only by those wielding a two-handed weapon, and Shackled Fists only by those fighting hand-to-hand.
> Fomor Hate: every Fomor you defeat widens the aggressive detection range of Fomors in Lufaise Meadows, Misareaux Coast, Phomiuna Aqueducts and Sacrarium. Defeating Tavnazian beastmen reverses it — 50 kills resets it from maximum. Resauchamet at (K-7) on the top floor of Tavnazian Safehold will tell you your current level.
> At maximum Fomor Hate (level 4), trading a Fomor Codex to a Stale Draft spawns the Swift Belt notorious monsters in Sacrarium — one per playable race.

#### Sengann
- Level: 58
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: Sound, Blood
- Job: Samurai
- Crystal: Dark
- Weak to: Fire +12.5%, Light +12.5%
- Resists: Ice -50%, Dark -50%
- Abilities: Aegis Schism, Barbed Crescent, Carnal Nightmare, Dancing Chains, Foxfire, Grim Halo, Netherspikes, Shackled Fists
- Zones: Lufaise Meadows (57)
- Spawn: Special (20:00-22:00, despawns at 4:00)
- Drops: Lineadach
- Notes:
    - Roughly 5,500-6,000 HP. Spawns between 20:00 and 22:00 at (F-8) on the cliff in Lufaise Meadows and despawns around 04:00.
    - Has an innate Zanshin effect, and its accuracy rises as its HP falls.
    - Uses Barbed Crescent regardless of TP, and nearly nonstop below 20% HP.
    - Melee attacks carry an additional curse effect that cuts about a third of maximum HP.
    - Immune or highly resistant to Bind, Sleep and Gravity, but not to Shadowbind; cannot be bound by Regurgitation.
    - Only aggressive while you hold Fomor Hate — it will not aggro to resting or low HP once hate is reset.

### Family: Ghost

*Ecosystem Undead · 86 recorded*

> Floating pieces of cloth possessed by spirits. Unaware of their passage into the afterlife, they return to possess their former clothing, and unwittingly sow death and misery with their deadly pranks.
> Possess the Double Attack trait.
> Despoil steals Cotton Cloth or Linen Cloth and inflicts Magic Defense Down.

    - Particularly weak to magic burst damage — Fire II from a geomancer deals a consistent 200 without a burst and 9,500 with one; Fire III reaches 13,000 with a burst.
    - Roughly 12,000 HP at level 135. Its weaknesses shift randomly between elements at level 135.

### Family: Qutrub

*Ecosystem Undead · 13 recorded*

> Takes double damage from every source, and has triple the HP of a typical monster.
> The damage multiplier double-dips, so hybrid weapon skills and skillchains are especially effective: a skillchain built off an already-doubled weapon skill can land around four times the usual damage, more again with a Holy Circle potency bonus.
> Abilities that restore HP or MP from the damage they deal, such as Spirit Taker, gain the same advantage as long as they work on undead.
> Black Mage type Qutrub carry Thief traits of the same level, which makes them more evasive than the Dark Knight type.
> Despoil: Qutrub Bandage, Qutrub Gorget.

#### Erle
- Level: 62
- Flags: NM, Links
- Detects: Sight
- Job: Warrior / Black Mage
- Crystal: Wind
- Weak to: Piercing +25%, Ranged +25%, Fire +30%, Lightning +30%, Light +30%, Ice +50%, Earth +30%, Water +30%, Dark +30%
- Resists: Wind -30%
- Spells: Aero III, Aeroga II, Tornado
- Zones: Rolanberry Fields [S] (62)
- Spawn: Lottery (off the fifth Death Jacket from above the first Goobbue on Widescan at (G-8)), Rolanberry Fields [S]
- Drops: Courser's Pugio
- Notes:
    - Lottery spawn from the fifth Death Jacket from above the first Goobbue on Widescan at (G-8). The window opens 90 minutes after the last defeat. Roughly 6,200 HP and 100 magic defence.
    - Links with, and is linked to by, other bees in the area.
    - Does not use TP moves at all.
    - Possesses a potent Enaero effect of around 50 per hit; it can be resisted with enough magic evasion (Baraera etc.).
    - Has a Double Attack rate of 12% and a Triple Attack rate of roughly 35% (traits: Double Attack, Triple Attack, Enaero).
    - Casts Aero III, Aeroga II, and Tornado. It lacks Fast Cast, so players can out-range Aeroga II and Tornado — but Erle loses claim and deaggros if a player stays too far out of range for too long.
    - Susceptible to Stun. Immune to Bind, Break, Gravity, Silence, and Sleep.

- Drops: Pursuer's Cuffs, Naga Somen, Vanya Clogs, Infused Earring
- Notes:
    - Geas Fete NM. Has access to all Beetle special attacks but seems to favour Rhino Guard whenever it is not already up.
    - Gains access to Rhinowrecker below 25% HP — keep it pointed away from weaker party members.
    - Rhino Guard grants an exceptionally strong Evasion Bonus but can be dispelled; Distract II causes it to have no effect.
    - Gains a Gravity aura after Rhino Attack.
    - Resists Silence, but is susceptible to Stun and other enfeebling magic.
    - Casts various AoE enfeebling and elemental spells, favouring Sleepga II and Silencega, and begins using progressively higher-tier Aeroga spells as its HP falls. Has a large amount of Fast Cast.
    - Can use Invincible at low HP.
    - Can be staggered by using a weapon skill while it is casting, or by hitting it with a spell as it readies a TP move (what the stagger actually does is unknown).

    - Possesses no TP moves.

#### Valkurm Imperator
- Level: 119
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Warrior
- Crystal: Wind
- Weak to: Piercing +25%, Ranged +25%, Fire +30%, Lightning +30%, Light +30%, Ice +50%, Water +30%, Dark +30%
- Abilities: Cursed Sphere, Debilitating Drone, Venom, Somersault
- Zones: Valkurm Dunes (119)
- Content: Unity: Wanted: Wanted 1
- Spawn: Unity NM — spawns at the Ethereal Junction (D-6)/(E-8)/(K-9) for 1,500 Unity Accolades, Valkurm Dunes
- Drops: Imperator's Wing, Imp. Wing Hairpin, Regal Pumps, Regal Pumps +1
- Notes:
    - Debilitating Drone inflicts a 3x attribute down which cannot be removed with Erase or Sacrifice.
    - Has very high evasion, so accuracy gear/sushi is recommended — 1,325 accuracy should cap the hit rate regardless of the -DEX.
    - Weak to piercing damage.
    - Can use TP attacks in rapid succession (such as 3x Cursed Sphere), so be prepared for heals.
    - Two Thieves skillchaining (Rudra's Storm > Rudra's Storm >> Darkness) can make short work of it.
    - Drops come from the Imperator's Coffer; its Imperator's Wing is used to spawn Tipuli. Also drops the Imperial Wing Hairpin +1, which is not in the item database.

#### Vermillion Fishfly
- Level: 125
- Flags: NM, Links
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Warrior / Red Mage
- Crystal: Wind
- Weak to: Piercing +25%, Ranged +25%, Fire +30%, Lightning +30%, Light +30%, Ice +50%, Water +30%, Dark +30%
- Abilities: Cursed Sphere, Venom, Somersault, Debilitating Drone
- Spells: Hastega, Slowga, Aero III, Aero IV, Aeroga III
- Zones: Lufaise Meadows (125)
- Content: Unity: Wanted: Wanted 2
- Spawn: Unity NM — rift locations (G-7)/(J-9)/(K-9) for 2,100 Unity Accolades, Lufaise Meadows
- Drops: Vermillion's Wing, Blistering Sallet, Blistering Sallet +1, Cacoethic Ring, Cacoethic Ring +1
- Image: mobimages/vermillion_fishfly.png
- Notes:
    - On spawning, 10 Vermillion Fishflies pop and attack whoever started the Unity fight (assisted by Vermillion Fishfly x7). Hate is not shared between the flies.
    - The flies cast Hastega, Slowga, Aero III, Aero IV, and Aeroga III. Hitting one with a physical weapon skill while it is casting procs a !!, interrupting the spell and terrorizing it for ~10 seconds.
    - The flies counter magic damage with Debilitating Drone regardless of TP.
    - Once a Vermillion Fishfly is defeated, all flies get a 1-hour animation, link hate to the main NM, and collectively weapon skill with Cursed Sphere (10’ AoE damage), Debilitating Drone (AoE random attribute down), Somersault (single-target damage), or Venom (conal damage and poison).
    - After any fly is killed, the remaining flies gain access to Silencega for the rest of the fight. It is unclear whether they are stronger in any other way.
    - Advisable to nuke them down with AoE damage (BLM/BLU) so several die at once.
    - All flies are immune to any form of sleep, bind, gravity, and petrification.
    - Drops come from Vermillion's Coffer; its Vermillion's Wing is used to spawn Akidu.

#### Selkit
- Level: 129
- Flags: NM, Links
- Detects: Sound
- Job: Warrior
- Crystal: Earth
- Weak to: Lightning +30%, Light +50%, Ice +50%, Water +30%
- Abilities: Hell Scissors, Earthbreaker, Venom Storm, Numbing Breath, Cold Breath, Evasion, Sharp Strike, Telsonic Tempest, Mighty Strikes
- Zones: Reisenjima (129)
- Content: Geas Fete: Reisenjima: Tier 1
- Spawn: Forced: the leader examines the ??? with a Selkit's pincer (Reisenjima); all members need Tribulens.
- Drops: Apate Ring, Herculean Trousers, Merlinic Crackows, Pellucid Stone, Fern Stone, Taupe Stone
- Image: mobimages/scorpion.png
- Notes:
    - Geas Fete NM. Takes drastically reduced magic damage. Trait: Double Attack.
    - Hell Scissors cuts the target to 5-10% of current HP and resets its enmity; used in response to Weapon Skills. High magic evasion mitigates the amount lost.
    - Frequent WS — or Trusts whose auto-attacks count as a WS (August, Balamor, Teodor, Arciela) — can lock it into using only Hell Scissors.
    - Earth Breaker: 40' AoE, very high damage and potent Stun. Mighty Strikes into Earth Breaker will one-shot anyone without damage reduction.
    - Venom Storm: 40' AoE with potent Poison. Can use Mighty Strikes multiple times below 50% HP.
    - Evasion grants it a 25% Slow aura that overrides Haste for 120s; Sharp Strike grants an Evasion Down aura for 120s.
    - Telsonic Tempest (Encumbrance) below 25% HP.
    - Unlocks the DEF+ Vorseal.

#### Grannus
- Flags: NM
- Detects: Sound, Scent
- Job: Warrior
- Crystal: Fire
- Weak to: Piercing +12.5%, Ice +30%, Earth +15%, Water +30%, Dark +15%
- Resists: Fire -95%, Wind -30%
- Abilities: Erosion Dust, Erratic Flutter, Exuviation, Magma Fan, Proboscis, Fire Break, Benumbing Blaze, Benediction
- Spells: Fire V, Firaga IV, Sleepga, Slowga, Addle
- Zones: Ruhotz Silvermines
- Spawn: Assistant Expedition 5 (Batallia Downs), Ruhotz Silvermines.
- Drops: Himthige, Huskarl Axe, Skrati Grip, Ravana's Axe
- Notes:
    - ~40,000 HP. Vermin-type, so the Vermin Killer boon from Intimidation Palimpsest works.
    - Assisted by up to five Grannus's Firebugs — they keep spawning while it is passive, so the count depends on how long you take to engage. They can be slept and/or kited away.
    - Auto Regen scales with the Firebugs present (~100 HP/tick per Firebug).
    - While readying a TP move it gains temporary Blaze Spikes worth up to ~200 damage, again scaling with Firebug count.
    - Benumbing Blaze is its unique TP move; Exuviation heals 3000+ HP per debuff removed.
    - Below 50% HP it uses Benediction once — this wakes any slept Firebugs in range.
    - Drops the Noxious grime key item.
    - Title: Grannus Garroter

#### Ignamoth
- Level: 81-84
- Flags: NM, Aggressive, Links
- Detects: True Sound, Magic
- Crystal: Fire
- Weak to: Ice +12.5%, Lightning
- Resists: Fire -50%
- Immune: Bind, Gravity, Sleep, Paralyze

- Drops: Octant
- Notes:
    - Lottery spawn from the Wamouras on the hill around (C-6)/(C-7)/(D-6)/(D-7), every 2+ hours. Four Wamouras spawn on the hill: two normal, two Wamoura Princes that morph over time. The placeholder is one of the two that spawn normally.
    - Placeholder ID 17027421.
    - Melee attacks have additional effect: Paralysis, and land for 300-400 damage per hit on a level 75 Ninja/Warrior, upwards of 500 on criticals.
    - Immune to Fire.
    - Susceptible to Blind, Slow, Stun and all forms of damage over time.
    - High Double Attack proc rate and a high rate of TP Regain.
    - Very weak to magic, as normal Wamouras are, and has very high defense.
    - Commonly taken down by 2-3 black mages kiting it around the small shed south of its spawn area; bring a support job for Refresh, expect Wamoura Prince and Phantasm adds, and expect adult Wamoura to link if the kill is slow.

#### Kalos Eunomia
- Level: 97-98
- Flags: NM, Aggressive
